Increase the model budget first
en.quote: 当明确规则或流程改进已能解决问题，或错误风险与收益不相称时，AI可能不是合适选择。先比较可行替代方案。

title.zh: 从业务问题到用例 → 什么时候不该用AI
title.en: From business problems to use cases → When not to use AI

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：客服找制度慢，选择能作为用例起点的唯一描述。
prompt.en: Exercise: support staff find policies slowly. Select the one usable starting brief.

reason.zh: a说明人、流程、问题与结果；b/c只有工具或活动。 回看「从业务问题到用例」。
reason.en: a names people, workflow, problem and outcome; b/c only name tools or activity. Revisit “From business problems to use cases”.

text.zh: 客服在查制度环节耗时；目标是缩短查找时间且保持质量
text.en: Support policy lookup is slow; reduce lookup time while preserving quality

text.zh: 让全员都聊天
text.en: Make everyone chat

text.zh: 购买最新模型
text.en: Buy the latest model

prompt.zh: 本演练：报价表只有许可证费，选出还应纳入比较的全部项目。
prompt.en: Exercise: the quote lists license fees only. Select all additional comparison items.

reason.zh: 交付能力和持续成本都会影响可行性；忽略条款会漏掉约束。 回看「自建、购买或合作」。
reason.en: Delivery capability and ongoing costs affect feasibility; ignoring terms hides constraints. Revisit “Build, buy or partner”.

text.zh: 忽略供应商条款
text.en: Ignore supplier terms

text.zh: 集成、维护和退出迁移成本
text.en: Integration, maintenance and exit costs

text.zh: 内部运维能力与交付期
text.en: Internal operating capability and deadline

prompt.zh: 本演练预设：数据不可用即暂停。项目收益评分最高但数据不可用，选择决策。
prompt.en: Exercise rule: unavailable data requires a pause. The highest-value project lacks data. Choose the decision.

reason.zh: 预设条件尚不满足；价值评分不能替代可行性验证。 回看「项目优先级」。
reason.en: The stated gate is unmet; value scores cannot replace feasibility checks. Revisit “Project prioritization”.

text.zh: 因收益最高立即扩展
text.en: Scale immediately because value is highest

text.zh: 暂停并验证数据准备
text.en: Pause and validate data readiness

text.zh: 删除停止条件
text.en: Delete stop conditions

prompt.zh: 本演练：固定税号格式校验由明确规则完全解决；AI方案成本更高且没有额外收益。选择方案。
prompt.en: Exercise: explicit rules fully validate a fixed tax-ID format. AI costs more with no extra benefit. Choose.

reason.zh: 题设中规则已满足目标；新增AI没有证明收益。 回看「什么时候不该用AI」。
reason.en: Rules already meet the stated goal; added AI has no demonstrated benefit. Revisit “When not to use AI”.

text.zh: 采用规则校验
text.en: Use rules validation

text.zh: 必须训练模型
text.en: Train a model regardless

text.zh: 用生成文本代替校验
text.en: Replace validation with generated prose

sections.title: 迁移与业务连续性 → 价值、可行性与硬性约束
sections.english: Migration and business continuity → Value, feasibility and hard constraints

lessons.title: 迁移与业务连续性
lessons.body: 切换流程或平台要检查数据准备、性能、权限、成本以及回退路径，避免演示成功后直接替换关键流程。
lessons.example: 先小范围试用新客服系统，保留可用的人工处理方式。
lessons.quote: 切换流程或平台要检查数据准备、性能、权限、成本以及回退路径，避免演示成功后直接替换关键流程。

en.title: Migration and business continuity
en.body: Plan dependencies, staged migration, fallback procedures and ownership to maintain essential operations.
en.example: Keep an approved fallback route during a system transition.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 问题、受益者与可观测结果
lessons.body: 用例要说明谁在什么流程遇到什么问题、现有基线是什么、预期改变如何测量，再选择合适能力。跨职能用例的成功标准会不同。
lessons.example: 客服看处理质量，销售看合格线索，研发看验证周期，开发看评审后交付质量。
lessons.boundary: 工具名称不是业务问题。
lessons.quote: 用例要说明谁在什么流程遇到什么问题、现有基线是什么、预期改变如何测量，再选择合适能力。跨职能用例的成功标准会不同。

en.title: Problem, beneficiary and outcome
en.body: State the affected workflow, beneficiaries, baseline and measurable outcome before selecting AI capabilities.
en.example: Support, sales, research and software teams require different outcome measures.
en.boundary: A tool name is not a business problem.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 自建、购买与合作的比较维度
lessons.body: 比较时间、预算、差异化需求、内部能力、集成、持续运营、供应商条款和退出成本。已有产品适配且交付期紧时，购买可能比自建更可行。
lessons.example: 缺少运维团队且三个月要上线，先核对现成服务的能力与约束。
lessons.boundary: 购买服务不免除本企业的数据和用途责任。
lessons.quote: 比较时间、预算、差异化需求、内部能力、集成、持续运营、供应商条款和退出成本。已有产品适配且交付期紧时，购买可能比自建更可行。

en.title: Build, buy and partner criteria
en.body: Compare delivery time, capability, differentiation, integration, operating support, supplier terms and exit costs.
en.example: With no operations team and a short deadline, evaluate a managed service's fit.
en.boundary: Buying a service does not transfer all use-case responsibilities.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 价值、可行性与硬性约束
lessons.body: 先识别必须满足的数据授权、安全和业务连续性条件，再比较价值、实施能力与战略契合度。高预期收益不能抵消尚未满足的硬约束。
lessons.example: 收益最高的项目没有合法可用资料，应先暂停补齐条件。
lessons.boundary: 评分模型用于辅助讨论，权重与门槛应明确。
lessons.quote: 先识别必须满足的数据授权、安全和业务连续性条件，再比较价值、实施能力与战略契合度。高预期收益不能抵消尚未满足的硬约束。

en.title: Value, feasibility and hard constraints
en.body: Check mandatory permissions and operational constraints before ranking value, feasibility and strategic fit.
en.example: Pause a high-return project when usable authorized data is unavailable.
en.boundary: Make scoring assumptions and mandatory gates explicit.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第2章 · 演示正常但无回退路径，是否直接替换关键流程？

是，之后再定责任

en.a: No; establish and validate fallback and readiness first
wrong: Yes; a demo represents all requests
Yes; assign responsibility later
en.quote: 切换流程或平台要检查数据准备、性能、权限、成本以及回退路径，避免演示成功后直接替换关键流程。

questions.q: 第2章 · 用例已有模型名，缺少基线，下一步应做什么？
questions.a: 记录现有流程表现并定义可测结果
wrong: 把模型名当基线
直接宣布成功
questions.quote: 用例要说明谁在什么流程遇到什么问题、现有基线是什么、预期改变如何测量，再选择合适能力。跨职能用例的成功标准会不同。

en.q: Chapter 2: A use case names a model but lacks a baseline. What next?
en.a: Record current performance and define measurable outcomes
wrong: Treat the model name as baseline
Declare success immediately
en.quote: 用例要说明谁在什么流程遇到什么问题、现有基线是什么、预期改变如何测量，再选择合适能力。跨职能用例的成功标准会不同。

questions.q: 第2章 · 交付期紧时是否只需选最低订阅费？
questions.a: 否，还需检查能力适配、条款和持续运营
wrong: 是，其他成本都相同
是，供应商承担全部用途责任
questions.quote: 比较时间、预算、差异化需求、内部能力、集成、持续运营、供应商条款和退出成本。已有产品适配且交付期紧时，购买可能比自建更可行。
questions.topic: Task 2.2 · 迁移与业务连续性 → 价值、可行性与硬性约束

en.q: Chapter 2: With a tight deadline, should the lowest subscription price decide?
en.a: No; check capability fit, terms and operations
wrong: Yes; all other costs are equal
Yes; suppliers own all use responsibilities
en.quote: 比较时间、预算、差异化需求、内部能力、集成、持续运营、供应商条款和退出成本。已有产品适配且交付期紧时，购买可能比自建更可行。

questions.q: 第2章 · 收益最高项目缺授权，如何处理？
questions.a: 暂停补齐授权条件再比较价值
wrong: 用收益评分覆盖授权缺口
先上线后补授权
questions.quote: 先识别必须满足的数据授权、安全和业务连续性条件，再比较价值、实施能力与战略契合度。高预期收益不能抵消尚未满足的硬约束。
questions.topic: Task 2.2 · 迁移与业务连续性 → 价值、可行性与硬性约束

en.q: Chapter 2: The highest-return project lacks authorization. What should happen?
en.a: Pause to meet authorization conditions before ranking value
wrong: Offset authorization with value points
Launch before obtaining permission
en.quote: 先识别必须满足的数据授权、安全和业务连续性条件，再比较价值、实施能力与战略契合度。高预期收益不能抵消尚未满足的硬约束。

title.zh: 迁移与业务连续性 → 价值、可行性与硬性约束
title.en: Migration and business continuity → Value, feasibility and hard constraints

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练按依赖排序：必须先验证准备，再小流量切换；异常后使用已验证回退。
prompt.en: Exercise dependencies: validate readiness before limited cutover; use the tested fallback if an exception occurs.

reason.zh: 回退在切换前就要可用；观察异常后才执行回退。 回看「迁移与业务连续性」。
reason.en: Fallback must be ready before cutover; execute it when observation detects an exception. Revisit “Migration and business continuity”.

text.zh: 小范围切换并观察
text.en: Cut over a limited scope and observe

text.zh: 异常触发回到原流程
text.en: On exception, return to the original process

text.zh: 验证数据、权限、性能和回退
text.en: Validate data, access, performance and fallback

prompt.zh: 本演练：目标是改善客服答复。选择应在选技术前明确的全部内容。
prompt.en: Exercise: improve support responses. Select everything needed before choosing technology.

reason.zh: 基线与结果应匹配受益者和流程；销售线索不能替代客服质量。 回看「问题、受益者与可观测结果」。
reason.en: Baseline and outcomes must match beneficiaries and workflow; sales leads cannot substitute for support quality. Revisit “Problem, beneficiary and outcome”.

text.zh: 客服工单流程与当前处理时间
text.en: Support workflow and current handling time

text.zh: 直接借用销售线索数作为唯一成功标准
text.en: Use sales-lead count as the sole success measure

text.zh: 答复质量与处理时间的目标口径
text.en: Definitions for response quality and handling-time goals

prompt.zh: 本演练：三个月上线且无运维团队；现成服务满足需求。选择合理下一步。
prompt.en: Exercise: launch in three months, no operations team, and a managed service fits needs. Choose the next step.

reason.zh: 条件使购买值得优先评估，但适配和责任仍要核验。 回看「自建、购买与合作的比较维度」。
reason.en: The conditions favor evaluating purchase, while fit and responsibilities still need checking. Revisit “Build, buy and partner criteria”.

text.zh: 评估购买方案的条款、集成和退出成本并保留用途责任
text.en: Evaluate purchase terms, integration and exit costs while retaining use responsibilities

text.zh: 购买后不再检查数据用途
text.en: Stop checking data use after purchase

text.zh: 无条件自建且不估维护
text.en: Build unconditionally without estimating maintenance

prompt.zh: 本演练：预算5，最低价值6，必须做授权审查。选项目，禁止项不可选。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 5, minimum value 6, authorization review required; blocked items cannot be selected.

reason.zh: 审查与获授权试点合计成本5价值6；禁止项即使价值高仍不可入选。 回看「价值、可行性与硬性约束」。
reason.en: Review plus authorized pilot cost 5 and yield value 6; blocked work remains ineligible despite its score. Revisit “Value, feasibility and hard constraints”.

text.zh: 授权审查，成本1，价值1
text.en: Authorization review: cost 1, value 1

text.zh: 获授权试点，成本4，价值5
text.en: Authorized pilot: cost 4, value 5

text.zh: 未授权高收益项目，禁止
text.en: Unauthorized high-return project: blocked

sections.title: 不使用AI也是方案 → 业务基线
sections.english: Non-AI alternatives → Business baseline

lessons.title: 不使用AI也是方案
lessons.body: 若明确规则、检索或流程改进已解决问题，应把它们纳入比较。也应停止不具备可验证收益、可用数据或可接受风险边界的AI方案。
lessons.example: 文件命名混乱先完善归档，而不是默认训练模型。
lessons.boundary: 暂停或终止是有效的项目决策。
lessons.quote: 若明确规则、检索或流程改进已解决问题，应把它们纳入比较。也应停止不具备可验证收益、可用数据或可接受风险边界的AI方案。

en.title: Non-AI alternatives
en.body: Compare rules, search and process redesign with AI; stop initiatives lacking feasible evidence or acceptable controls.
en.example: Fix document organization before assuming model training is needed.
en.boundary: Pausing or ending a project can be appropriate.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 切换、回退与业务连续性
lessons.body: 迁移前验证新旧系统表现、接口、数据准备和成本，明确切换窗口、责任人、回退触发及恢复方式；迁移成功不能只看系统已启动。
lessons.example: 先在部分请求上验证新平台，异常时可回到原处理流程。
lessons.boundary: 回退方案也需要演练与可用资源。
lessons.quote: 迁移前验证新旧系统表现、接口、数据准备和成本，明确切换窗口、责任人、回退触发及恢复方式；迁移成功不能只看系统已启动。

en.title: Cutover, rollback and continuity
en.body: Validate performance, interfaces, data and costs and define cutover owners, rollback triggers and recovery.
en.example: Validate on a limited traffic share with a functioning fallback.
en.boundary: A fallback must be tested and resourced.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 有形与无形收益
lessons.body: KPI应对应业务目标。有形收益如实际节支或收入，无形收益如满意度；两者需要清楚的测量方式，不能随意互相折算。
lessons.example: 同时记录客服处理时间与答复质量，避免只优化生成速度。
lessons.quote: KPI应对应业务目标。有形收益如实际节支或收入，无形收益如满意度；两者需要清楚的测量方式，不能随意互相折算。

en.title: Tangible and intangible benefits
en.body: Distinguish measurable financial or operational benefits from less direct effects such as trust or experience; state measurement assumptions.
en.example: Measure time saved and assess customer experience separately.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 业务基线
lessons.body: 实施前记录可比较的原流程表现，包括时间、成本和质量。上线后保持口径一致，才能合理讨论改善。
lessons.example: 原流程60分钟，AI生成10分钟且复核15分钟，净节省是35分钟。
lessons.quote: 实施前记录可比较的原流程表现，包括时间、成本和质量。上线后保持口径一致，才能合理讨论改善。

en.title: Business baseline
en.body: A measured reference for the existing process, needed for a meaningful before-and-after comparison.
en.example: Record current handling time and error rates before a pilot.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第2章 · AI方案没有可用数据，能否因已投入很多而继续？
questions.a: 不能，应暂停并核验准备条件或替代方案
wrong: 能，沉没成本必须追回
能，删除数据要求即可
questions.quote: 若明确规则、检索或流程改进已解决问题，应把它们纳入比较。也应停止不具备可验证收益、可用数据或可接受风险边界的AI方案。
questions.topic: Task 2.3 · 不使用AI也是方案 → 业务基线

en.q: Chapter 2: An AI proposal lacks usable data. Does past spending justify continuing?
en.a: No; pause and assess readiness or alternatives
wrong: Yes; sunk spending must be recovered
Yes; remove the data requirement
en.quote: 若明确规则、检索或流程改进已解决问题，应把它们纳入比较。也应停止不具备可验证收益、可用数据或可接受风险边界的AI方案。

questions.q: 第2章 · 已有回退文档但未演练，下一步是什么？
questions.a: 演练并确认资源和恢复方式可用
wrong: 直接标记迁移成功
删除回退步骤简化上线
questions.quote: 迁移前验证新旧系统表现、接口、数据准备和成本，明确切换窗口、责任人、回退触发及恢复方式；迁移成功不能只看系统已启动。
questions.topic: Task 2.3 · 不使用AI也是方案 → 业务基线

en.q: Chapter 2: A rollback document exists but has never been tested. What next?
en.a: Test the fallback and verify resources and recovery
wrong: Mark migration successful
Delete rollback steps to simplify launch
en.quote: 迁移前验证新旧系统表现、接口、数据准备和成本，明确切换窗口、责任人、回退触发及恢复方式；迁移成功不能只看系统已启动。

questions.q: 第2章 · 满意度提高能直接计为已实现现金收益吗？
questions.a: 不能，应独立测量并说明换算依据
wrong: 能，每分固定等于一万元
不能测量无形收益
questions.quote: KPI应对应业务目标。有形收益如实际节支或收入，无形收益如满意度；两者需要清楚的测量方式，不能随意互相折算。
questions.topic: Task 2.3 · 不使用AI也是方案 → 业务基线

en.q: Chapter 2: Can improved satisfaction directly count as realized cash benefit?
en.a: No; measure it separately and justify any conversion
wrong: Yes; every point equals 10,000
Intangible benefits cannot be measured
en.quote: KPI应对应业务目标。有形收益如实际节支或收入，无形收益如满意度；两者需要清楚的测量方式，不能随意互相折算。

questions.q: 第2章 · 旧流程60分钟，新流程25分钟，按同口径节省多少？
questions.a: 35分钟
wrong: 50分钟
60分钟
questions.quote: 实施前记录可比较的原流程表现，包括时间、成本和质量。上线后保持口径一致，才能合理讨论改善。
questions.topic: Task 2.3 · 不使用AI也是方案 → 业务基线

en.q: Chapter 2: Old process takes 60 minutes, new process 25. Comparable saving?
en.a: 35 minutes
wrong: 50 minutes
60 minutes
en.quote: 实施前记录可比较的原流程表现，包括时间、成本和质量。上线后保持口径一致，才能合理讨论改善。

title.zh: 不使用AI也是方案 → 业务基线
title.en: Non-AI alternatives → Business baseline

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：规则方案已满足全部目标，AI方案无可验证增益且风险超出接受边界。选择动作。
prompt.en: Exercise: rules meet every goal; AI has no verifiable added value and exceeds risk tolerance. Choose.

reason.zh: 停止没有可验证价值或可接受风险边界的方案，是有依据的决策。 回看「不使用AI也是方案」。
reason.en: Stopping work without verifiable value or acceptable controls is an evidence-based decision. Revisit “Non-AI alternatives”.

text.zh: 为体现创新继续AI
text.en: Continue AI to appear innovative

text.zh: 停止AI方案，保留满足目标的规则方案
text.en: Stop the AI proposal and retain the adequate rules solution

text.zh: 忽略风险边界
text.en: Ignore the risk boundary

prompt.zh: 本演练：故障接手必须由可全天值班的团队负责。销售组(sales)仅工作日白天值班，运营组(ops)全天值班。恢复路径必须已通过恢复演练：旧系统(legacy)已通过，新平台(new)尚未演练。政策规定失败请求比例超过2%即回退；本次共1000请求，30次失败。错误交接单写着负责人sales、触发阈值5%、恢复路径new。根据职责、政策和验证记录修复交接单；团队与路径填括号内英文编码，阈值填百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: incident ownership requires around-the-clock coverage. Sales (sales) covers weekday daytime only; Operations (ops) covers all hours. Recovery must use a route that passed a restoration drill: the old system (legacy) passed, while the new platform (new) is untested. Policy requires rollback when failed requests exceed 2%; this run had 30 failures out of 1,000 requests. The faulty handover lists owner sales, threshold 5%, route new. Repair it using duties, policy and validation evidence. Enter the team and route codes in parentheses and a numeric percentage for the threshold.

reason.zh: 只有ops满足全天故障接手职责，只有legacy通过恢复演练；阈值按预先政策修正为2，而不是把本次实际失败率3%写成阈值。本次3%超过2%，应由ops启动已验证的legacy路径。回看「切换、回退与业务连续性」。
reason.en: Only ops meets the coverage requirement, and only legacy passed the recovery drill. The policy threshold is 2, distinct from this run’s actual 3% failure rate. Because 3% exceeds 2%, ops should initiate the verified legacy route. Revisit “Cutover, rollback and continuity”.

label.zh: 故障责任团队编码（原值sales）

prompt.zh: 本演练将指标分入“可核验金额”或“单独测量的体验”；不作金额折算。
prompt.en: Exercise: classify measures as verifiable money or separately measured experience; do not convert experience into cash.

reason.zh: 已兑现金额与体验改善都可有价值，但后者没有题设支持的现金换算。 回看「有形与无形收益」。
reason.en: Realized money and experience can both matter, but no cash conversion for experience is supported here. Revisit “Tangible and intangible benefits”.

text.zh: 可核验金额
text.en: Verifiable money

text.zh: 体验指标
text.en: Experience measure

text.zh: 已兑现支出减少2万元
text.en: Realized spending reduction of 20,000

text.zh: 满意度问卷提高
text.en: Improved satisfaction survey

text.zh: 已收到新增收入
text.en: Additional revenue actually received

prompt.zh: 本演练：旧流程60分钟，新流程生成10分钟、复核15分钟，其他环节相同。填净节省分钟。
prompt.en: Exercise: old process 60 minutes; new generation 10 and review 15; all other stages unchanged. Enter net minutes saved.

reason.zh: 60−10−15=35；只减生成时间会漏掉人工复核。 回看「业务基线」。
reason.en: 60−10−15=35; subtracting generation alone omits human review. Revisit “Business baseline”.

sections.title: 收益与ROI → 结果指标与活动指标
sections.english: Benefits and ROI → Outcome and activity measures

lessons.title: 收益与ROI
lessons.body: 简单ROI为（同期间收益减成本）除以成本。完整成本应覆盖部署、调用、培训、维护和复核，避免重复计算同一份收益。
lessons.example: 释放工时不自动等于现金节支，也不能同时无依据地再记作新增收入。
lessons.quote: 简单ROI为（同期间收益减成本）除以成本。完整成本应覆盖部署、调用、培训、维护和复核，避免重复计算同一份收益。

en.title: Benefits and ROI
en.body: ROI compares net benefit with investment over a defined period; include ongoing costs and explicit assumptions.
en.example: If benefits are 150 and costs are 100, ROI is (150-100)/100 = 50%.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 先导性指标
lessons.body: 先导指标用于较早观察成功条件，结果指标用于观察已实现的成果。先导信号有价值，但不构成最终成功保证。
lessons.example: 合适的活跃使用与流程采用可作为信号，仍需观察实际质量和业务价值。
lessons.quote: 先导指标用于较早观察成功条件，结果指标用于观察已实现的成果。先导信号有价值，但不构成最终成功保证。

en.title: Leading indicators
en.body: Early measures signal likely progress but are not proof of realized business value.
en.example: Usage can inform adoption monitoring without proving improved profit.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 成本规划与优化
lessons.body: 明确初期和持续成本、用量假设与预算边界；观察实际调用和复核开销，在质量约束下优化方案。
lessons.example: 比较方案时把培训、集成、监测和人工复核一起计入。
lessons.quote: 明确初期和持续成本、用量假设与预算边界；观察实际调用和复核开销，在质量约束下优化方案。

en.title: Cost planning and optimization
en.body: Account for development, data, integration, inference, monitoring, support and maintenance over the lifecycle.
en.example: Include review effort and ongoing operating costs in the budget.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 结果指标与活动指标
lessons.body: 活动指标记录做了多少，如开通账号；结果指标记录业务改变，如差错率、处理周期、转化率。效率必须与质量和复核代价一起看。
lessons.example: 账号增长但处理错误增加，不能仅凭采用率宣布成功。
lessons.boundary: 单一速度指标容易掩盖质量损失。
lessons.quote: 活动指标记录做了多少，如开通账号；结果指标记录业务改变，如差错率、处理周期、转化率。效率必须与质量和复核代价一起看。

en.title: Outcome and activity measures
en.body: Activity measures track use; outcome measures track changed results. Evaluate speed alongside quality and review effort.
en.example: Higher adoption with more errors is insufficient evidence of success.
en.boundary: Speed alone can hide quality losses.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第2章 · 收益150、完整成本100，同期简单ROI是多少？
questions.quote: 简单ROI为（同期间收益减成本）除以成本。完整成本应覆盖部署、调用、培训、维护和复核，避免重复计算同一份收益。

en.q: Chapter 2: Benefits 150 and full costs 100 over the same period. Simple ROI?

questions.q: 第2章 · 使用频率上升是否已证明收益兑现？
questions.a: 否，还需观察质量和业务结果
wrong: 是，使用就是利润
是，不需后续指标
questions.quote: 先导指标用于较早观察成功条件，结果指标用于观察已实现的成果。先导信号有价值，但不构成最终成功保证。
questions.topic: Task 2.4 · 收益与ROI → 结果指标与活动指标

en.q: Chapter 2: Does higher usage prove benefits were realized?
en.a: No; observe quality and business outcomes
wrong: Yes; usage equals profit
Yes; no later measures needed
en.quote: 先导指标用于较早观察成功条件，结果指标用于观察已实现的成果。先导信号有价值，但不构成最终成功保证。

questions.q: 第2章 · 调用费下降但复核成本大增，能否直接声称优化成功？
questions.a: 不能，需检查完整成本及质量
wrong: 能，只看调用费
能，人工时间没有成本
questions.quote: 明确初期和持续成本、用量假设与预算边界；观察实际调用和复核开销，在质量约束下优化方案。
questions.topic: Task 2.4 · 收益与ROI → 结果指标与活动指标

en.q: Chapter 2: Call fees fall but review cost rises sharply. Is optimization established?
en.a: No; check full costs and quality
wrong: Yes; only call fees matter
Yes; human time has no cost
en.quote: 明确初期和持续成本、用量假设与预算边界；观察实际调用和复核开销，在质量约束下优化方案。

questions.q: 第2章 · 开通一千账号能独立证明效率提高吗？
questions.a: 不能，需看含质量与复核成本的业务结果
wrong: 能，账号越多效率必然越高
能，不需测量业务
questions.quote: 活动指标记录做了多少，如开通账号；结果指标记录业务改变，如差错率、处理周期、转化率。效率必须与质量和复核代价一起看。
questions.topic: Task 2.4 · 收益与ROI → 结果指标与活动指标

en.q: Chapter 2: Do 1,000 accounts alone prove improved efficiency?
en.a: No; inspect outcomes including quality and review costs
wrong: Yes; more accounts always mean more efficiency
Yes; workflow measurement is unnecessary
en.quote: 活动指标记录做了多少，如开通账号；结果指标记录业务改变，如差错率、处理周期、转化率。效率必须与质量和复核代价一起看。

prompt.zh: 本演练：同年收益180万元，部署40、调用20、培训10、维护20、复核10万元。填简单ROI百分数。

reason.zh: 完整成本100，净收益80，因此ROI=80/100=80%；不能漏复核或把收益当净收益。 回看「收益与ROI」。
reason.en: Full costs are 100 and net benefit 80, so ROI is 80%; include review and subtract costs. Revisit “Benefits and ROI”.

prompt.zh: 本演练：将培训完成率与已实现净收益分到相应类别。

reason.en: Training may support success conditions, but final net benefit requires separate observation. Revisit “Leading indicators”.

sections.title: 有形收益与无形收益 → 释放产能与现金节省
sections.english: Tangible and intangible benefits → Released capacity and cash savings

lessons.title: 有形收益与无形收益
lessons.body: 有形收益可以形成可核验的金额或运营变化；满意度、信任等无形收益应设计独立测量，不能任意折算成已经实现的现金。
lessons.example: 分别报告已兑现成本减少与客户满意度变化。
lessons.boundary: 无形收益不是无需证据的收益。
lessons.quote: 有形收益可以形成可核验的金额或运营变化；满意度、信任等无形收益应设计独立测量，不能任意折算成已经实现的现金。

en.title: Tangible and intangible benefits
en.body: Measure financial and operational effects separately from experience or trust; justify any monetary conversion.
en.example: Report realized cost reductions and satisfaction changes separately.
en.boundary: Intangible benefits still require evidence.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 可比较基线与归因
lessons.body: 记录实施前同口径指标，并尽量控制任务难度、业务量和时间因素。对照组或分阶段试验有助于区分AI效果与同期其他改变。
lessons.example: 相同类型工单比较总处理时间，包括人工复核。
lessons.boundary: 上线前后数字不同，不自动证明因果关系。
lessons.quote: 记录实施前同口径指标，并尽量控制任务难度、业务量和时间因素。对照组或分阶段试验有助于区分AI效果与同期其他改变。

en.title: Comparable baselines and attribution
en.body: Use consistent definitions and comparable workloads; controls or staged tests help distinguish AI effects from other changes.
en.example: Compare similar tickets using total handling time including review.
en.boundary: A before-and-after difference alone does not prove causation.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: ROI公式与核算边界
lessons.body: 简单ROI等于同期收益减同期完整成本，再除以同期完整成本。明确期间、单位、收益实现条件和成本范围，才能比较不同方案。
lessons.example: 收益150万元、完整成本100万元，ROI为50%。
lessons.boundary: 不能用净收益除以收益冒充ROI。
lessons.quote: 简单ROI等于同期收益减同期完整成本，再除以同期完整成本。明确期间、单位、收益实现条件和成本范围，才能比较不同方案。

en.title: ROI and accounting boundaries
en.body: Simple ROI is net benefit divided by total cost over a consistent period; define units, scope and realization assumptions.
en.example: Benefits of 150 and total costs of 100 yield a 50% ROI.
en.boundary: Net benefit divided by benefits is not this ROI definition.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 释放产能与现金节省
lessons.body: 节省工时可释放产能，但只有支出实际减少才构成现金成本节省。若把产能用于新增产出，还需证明需求、人员安排和新增收入能够实现。
lessons.example: 每周省十小时但工资未减少，先记为可用产能。
lessons.boundary: 同一批省时不能无依据地重复计入减员与新增收益。
lessons.quote: 节省工时可释放产能，但只有支出实际减少才构成现金成本节省。若把产能用于新增产出，还需证明需求、人员安排和新增收入能够实现。

en.title: Released capacity and cash savings
en.body: Freed time is capacity; cash savings require actual expenditure reduction. Additional output needs realization evidence.
en.example: Ten freed hours with unchanged payroll are released capacity.
en.boundary: Do not double-count the same time saving.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第2章 · 无形收益应该如何处理？
questions.a: 设计独立证据与测量口径
wrong: 忽略全部无形收益
自由填现金数字
questions.quote: 有形收益可以形成可核验的金额或运营变化；满意度、信任等无形收益应设计独立测量，不能任意折算成已经实现的现金。
questions.topic: Task 2.5 · 有形收益与无形收益 → 释放产能与现金节省

en.q: Chapter 2: How should intangible benefits be handled?
en.a: Define separate evidence and measurement
wrong: Ignore all intangible benefits
Assign arbitrary cash figures
en.quote: 有形收益可以形成可核验的金额或运营变化；满意度、信任等无形收益应设计独立测量，不能任意折算成已经实现的现金。

questions.q: 第2章 · 上线后处理时间下降能单独证明AI造成改善吗？
questions.a: 不能，还需检查口径、任务构成和同期变化
wrong: 能，时间顺序就证明因果
能，忽略对照也一样
questions.quote: 记录实施前同口径指标，并尽量控制任务难度、业务量和时间因素。对照组或分阶段试验有助于区分AI效果与同期其他改变。
questions.topic: Task 2.5 · 有形收益与无形收益 → 释放产能与现金节省

en.q: Chapter 2: Does lower post-launch handling time alone prove AI caused it?
en.a: No; check definitions, task mix and concurrent changes
wrong: Yes; sequence proves causation
Yes; controls add nothing
en.quote: 记录实施前同口径指标，并尽量控制任务难度、业务量和时间因素。对照组或分阶段试验有助于区分AI效果与同期其他改变。

questions.q: 第2章 · 一方案用月成本配年收益，能直接与同期ROI比较吗？
questions.a: 不能，先统一期间、单位和成本范围
wrong: 能，只要数字大
能，只比较收益总额
questions.quote: 简单ROI等于同期收益减同期完整成本，再除以同期完整成本。明确期间、单位、收益实现条件和成本范围，才能比较不同方案。
questions.topic: Task 2.5 · 有形收益与无形收益 → 释放产能与现金节省

en.q: Chapter 2: Can monthly costs paired with yearly benefits be compared as a consistent-period ROI?
en.a: No; align period, units and cost scope
wrong: Yes, if the figures are large
Yes; compare benefits alone
en.quote: 简单ROI等于同期收益减同期完整成本，再除以同期完整成本。明确期间、单位、收益实现条件和成本范围，才能比较不同方案。

questions.q: 第2章 · 省时后工资不变，最稳妥的直接报告是什么？
questions.a: 释放产能，现金收益需另证
wrong: 已经减少工资支出
同批工时同时算减员和新增收入
questions.quote: 节省工时可释放产能，但只有支出实际减少才构成现金成本节省。若把产能用于新增产出，还需证明需求、人员安排和新增收入能够实现。
questions.topic: Task 2.5 · 有形收益与无形收益 → 释放产能与现金节省

en.q: Chapter 2: Time is saved but payroll unchanged. What is directly supported?
en.a: Released capacity; cash benefits need further evidence
wrong: Payroll spending has fallen
Count the same hours as both headcount cuts and new revenue
en.quote: 节省工时可释放产能，但只有支出实际减少才构成现金成本节省。若把产能用于新增产出，还需证明需求、人员安排和新增收入能够实现。

title.zh: 有形收益与无形收益 → 释放产能与现金节省
title.en: Tangible and intangible benefits → Released capacity and cash savings

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：实际支出减少5万元，信任问卷提高但无货币换算依据。选择报告。
prompt.en: Exercise: spending falls by 50,000; trust surveys improve without a monetary conversion basis. Choose a report.

reason.zh: 金额已核验，信任有独立测量；不能凭空赋予现金额。 回看「有形收益与无形收益」。
reason.en: Money is verified and trust measured separately; no invented cash value is justified. Revisit “Tangible and intangible benefits”.

text.zh: 信任无需测量
text.en: Trust needs no measurement

text.zh: 将信任提升记作另5万元现金
text.en: Record trust improvement as another 50,000 cash

text.zh: 分别报告5万元支出减少与信任问卷变化
text.en: Report the 50,000 reduction separately from trust survey changes

prompt.zh: 本演练：同期工单难度下降且上线AI。选择更能区分AI效果的下一轮设计。
prompt.en: Exercise: tickets became easier while AI launched. Select the next design that better distinguishes AI effects.

reason.zh: 匹配与对照减少同期变化干扰；不同任务直接比较不能支持该归因。 回看「可比较基线与归因」。
reason.en: Matching and comparison reduce confounding; unlike tasks do not support attribution. Revisit “Comparable baselines and attribution”.

text.zh: 只比较去年最难工单和本月最易工单
text.en: Compare last year’s hardest with this month’s easiest tickets

text.zh: 把所有改善都记给AI
text.en: Attribute every improvement to AI

text.zh: 按难度和业务量匹配，统一含复核口径设置对照
text.en: Match difficulty and volume, use review-inclusive definitions and a comparison group

prompt.zh: 本演练：一年收益240万元，完整成本160万元；填简单ROI百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: one-year benefits 240 and full costs 160. Enter simple ROI percent.

reason.zh: 净收益80，除以完整成本160得50%；除收益240不是此处ROI。 回看「ROI公式与核算边界」。
reason.en: Net benefit 80 divided by full costs 160 is 50%; dividing by benefits is a different measure. Revisit “ROI and accounting boundaries”.

prompt.zh: 本演练：工资支出不变，每周释放10小时；另有已取消的外包费2000元。分类。
prompt.en: Exercise: payroll unchanged, 10 hours freed weekly; a separate 2,000 outsourcing expense was actually eliminated. Classify.

reason.zh: 时间释放尚未减少支出；取消支出才有已实现现金节省证据。 回看「释放产能与现金节省」。
reason.en: Freed time has not reduced spending; canceled expense provides realized cash evidence. Revisit “Released capacity and cash savings”.

text.zh: 释放产能
text.en: Released capacity

text.zh: 现金节省
text.en: Cash savings

text.zh: 工资不变的10小时
text.en: 10 hours with unchanged payroll

text.zh: 已取消的外包支出
text.en: Eliminated outsourcing spend

sections.title: 先导信号与滞后结果 → 业务模式转型
sections.english: Leading and lagging indicators → Business model transformation

lessons.title: 先导信号与滞后结果
lessons.body: 培训完成、使用频率等可作为早期信号；留存、服务质量、净收益等结果需要后续观察。应说明预期联系，并检验先导指标能否预测结果。
lessons.example: 培训后继续追踪独立核验正确率，而不只统计出勤。
lessons.boundary: 先导指标向好不等于收益已兑现。
lessons.quote: 培训完成、使用频率等可作为早期信号；留存、服务质量、净收益等结果需要后续观察。应说明预期联系，并检验先导指标能否预测结果。

en.title: Leading and lagging indicators
en.body: Training and usage can signal progress, but later quality and value outcomes must validate their usefulness.
en.example: Track verification performance after training, not attendance alone.
en.boundary: Positive leading indicators are not realized benefits.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 全生命周期成本
lessons.body: 预算包括数据整理、集成、部署、调用或计算、培训、人工复核、监测、维护和退出迁移。按业务量变化分析单位成本和总成本。
lessons.example: 减少模型调用费却增加大量人工复核，可能没有降低完整成本。
lessons.boundary: 单次调用价格不能代表系统总成本。
lessons.quote: 预算包括数据整理、集成、部署、调用或计算、培训、人工复核、监测、维护和退出迁移。按业务量变化分析单位成本和总成本。

en.title: Lifecycle cost
en.body: Include data, integration, deployment, usage, training, review, monitoring, maintenance and exit costs.
en.example: Cheaper inference may not lower total cost if review effort rises.
en.boundary: Per-call price is not total system cost.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 竞争格局
lessons.body: 比较客户需求、竞争者能力和自己的独特条件，找到AI可改善的业务环节，而不是仅追随流行工具。
lessons.example: 同样购买一个模型，并不意味着获得与竞争者不同的能力。
lessons.quote: 比较客户需求、竞争者能力和自己的独特条件，找到AI可改善的业务环节，而不是仅追随流行工具。

en.title: Competitive landscape
en.body: Assess industry conditions, competitors and customer expectations before choosing an AI investment.
en.example: Identify a customer need rather than copying a competitor's demo.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 业务模式转型
lessons.body: AI可能改变产品、服务、交付或价值获取方式。评估客户价值与运营要求，而不是只给原流程加一个聊天窗口。
lessons.example: 将一次性报告服务改成持续辅助决策，需要新的数据维护和服务流程。
lessons.quote: AI可能改变产品、服务、交付或价值获取方式。评估客户价值与运营要求，而不是只给原流程加一个聊天窗口。

en.title: Business model transformation
en.body: AI can change how value is created, delivered and captured, beyond automating an existing task.
en.example: Consider whether a personalized service changes the revenue model.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第2章 · 培训完成率100%，下一步应怎样评估？
questions.a: 追踪能力表现与后续质量结果
wrong: 立即认定净收益为正
停止所有后续观察
questions.quote: 培训完成、使用频率等可作为早期信号；留存、服务质量、净收益等结果需要后续观察。应说明预期联系，并检验先导指标能否预测结果。
questions.topic: Task 2.6 · 先导信号与滞后结果 → 业务模式转型

en.q: Chapter 2: Training completion is 100%. What should evaluation do next?
en.a: Track capability performance and later quality outcomes
wrong: Immediately declare positive net benefit
Stop all further observation
en.quote: 培训完成、使用频率等可作为早期信号；留存、服务质量、净收益等结果需要后续观察。应说明预期联系，并检验先导指标能否预测结果。

questions.q: 第2章 · 调用量翻倍时应重看什么？
questions.a: 单位成本、总成本与复核等配套成本
wrong: 只看原月套餐价格
认为总成本不会变化
questions.quote: 预算包括数据整理、集成、部署、调用或计算、培训、人工复核、监测、维护和退出迁移。按业务量变化分析单位成本和总成本。
questions.topic: Task 2.6 · 先导信号与滞后结果 → 业务模式转型

en.q: Chapter 2: What should be revisited when call volume doubles?
en.a: Unit cost, total cost and related review costs
wrong: Only the original monthly plan price
Assume total costs never change
en.quote: 预算包括数据整理、集成、部署、调用或计算、培训、人工复核、监测、维护和退出迁移。按业务量变化分析单位成本和总成本。

questions.q: 第2章 · 竞争者购买同一模型，是否意味着双方获得同等业务价值？
questions.a: 不一定，需求、流程和自身条件不同
wrong: 一定，模型相同价值相同
一定，价格决定全部价值
questions.quote: 比较客户需求、竞争者能力和自己的独特条件，找到AI可改善的业务环节，而不是仅追随流行工具。
questions.topic: Task 2.6 · 先导信号与滞后结果 → 业务模式转型

en.q: Chapter 2: If competitors buy the same model, do they gain equal business value?
en.a: Not necessarily; needs, workflows and conditions differ
wrong: Yes; identical models give identical value
Yes; price determines all value
en.quote: 比较客户需求、竞争者能力和自己的独特条件，找到AI可改善的业务环节，而不是仅追随流行工具。

questions.q: 第2章 · 原产品仅改名“AI版”，能据此认定业务模式已转型吗？
questions.a: 不能，还需检查价值、交付或价值获取变化
wrong: 能，名称足以证明
能，界面有AI字样即可
questions.quote: AI可能改变产品、服务、交付或价值获取方式。评估客户价值与运营要求，而不是只给原流程加一个聊天窗口。
questions.topic: Task 2.6 · 先导信号与滞后结果 → 业务模式转型

en.q: Chapter 2: A product is renamed “AI edition.” Does this establish business-model transformation?
en.a: No; examine value, delivery or value-capture changes
wrong: Yes; naming proves it
Yes; an AI label suffices
en.quote: AI可能改变产品、服务、交付或价值获取方式。评估客户价值与运营要求，而不是只给原流程加一个聊天窗口。

title.zh: 先导信号与滞后结果 → 业务模式转型

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练要求先记录培训，再测独立核验正确率，最后检查服务质量。按该验证依赖排序。
prompt.en: Exercise: record training first, test independent verification accuracy next, then inspect service quality. Order these dependencies.

reason.zh: 先导活动需通过能力与业务结果检验联系；出勤不能代替后两项。 回看「先导信号与滞后结果」。
reason.en: Leading activity needs capability and outcome checks; attendance cannot replace them. Revisit “Leading and lagging indicators”.

text.zh: 测独立核验正确率
text.en: Measure independent verification accuracy

text.zh: 检查后续服务质量
text.en: Inspect later service quality

text.zh: 记录培训完成
text.en: Record training completion

prompt.zh: 本演练年度预算：数据整理10、集成20、调用30、培训5、复核15、监测维护10、退出准备10（万元）。求总成本。
prompt.en: Exercise annual budget: data 10, integration 20, calls 30, training 5, review 15, monitoring/maintenance 10, exit preparation 10. Sum costs in the same unit.

reason.zh: 各项合计100；只报调用30会漏掉数据、人工与生命周期支出。 回看「全生命周期成本」。
reason.en: The sum is 100; reporting calls alone omits data, human and lifecycle expenses. Revisit “Lifecycle cost”.

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行上线聊天机器人，本企业投诉集中在退款等待。选择先调查的内容。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor launches a chatbot; your complaints concern refund delays. Choose the first investigation.

reason.zh: 投资需要连接客户问题与自身条件；复制工具无法证明能解决退款障碍。 回看「竞争格局」。
reason.en: Investment needs a link to customer problems and local conditions; imitation does not establish a refund solution. Revisit “Competitive landscape”.

text.zh: 直接复制同行采购清单
text.en: Copy the competitor purchasing list

text.zh: 同行界面的配色
text.en: Competitor interface colors

text.zh: 退款流程障碍、客户期待与自身可改善环节
text.en: Refund workflow barriers, customer expectations and improvable steps

prompt.zh: 本演练：一次性报告转为持续决策服务。选择必须重新评估的全部事项。
prompt.en: Exercise: one-off reports become continuous decision support. Select all items requiring reassessment.

reason.zh: 持续服务改变交付与维护要求；标签不能替代客户价值和运营方案。 回看「业务模式转型」。
reason.en: Continuous service changes delivery and maintenance; labels cannot replace value and operations. Revisit “Business model transformation”.

text.zh: 持续客户价值与服务交付流程
text.en: Ongoing customer value and service delivery

text.zh: 只修改产品标签
text.en: Change only the product label

text.zh: 数据维护和运营责任
text.en: Data maintenance and operational ownership

sections.title: 可持续优势 → 价值主张、交付与收益逻辑
sections.english: Sustainable advantage → Value proposition, delivery and revenue

lessons.title: 可持续优势
lessons.body: 可持续优势往往来自相关数据、流程、组织能力和反馈的组合。单一工具上线不保证长期优势。
lessons.example: 把客户反馈持续转成流程改进，比只记录软件安装数更有意义。
lessons.quote: 可持续优势往往来自相关数据、流程、组织能力和反馈的组合。单一工具上线不保证长期优势。

en.title: Sustainable advantage
en.body: Durable advantage depends on capabilities, workflows, data and learning that competitors cannot easily reproduce.
en.example: A widely available model alone is unlikely to be a lasting differentiator.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 投资与成熟度
lessons.body: 投资规模应结合行业变化、竞争压力、组织准备度及风险承受能力。需要验证条件与分阶段投入。
lessons.example: 在数据基础不稳时，先投入治理与小范围验证，而非立即全企业扩展。
lessons.quote: 投资规模应结合行业变化、竞争压力、组织准备度及风险承受能力。需要验证条件与分阶段投入。

en.title: Investment and maturity
en.body: Match investment to organizational readiness, competitive conditions and risk tolerance; stage commitments around evidence.
en.example: Improve data governance before expanding an unproven enterprise rollout.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 客户问题与竞争位置
lessons.body: 分析竞争变化如何影响客户期待、交付效率和价值链，再决定投资方向。相同工具在不同业务条件下可能产生不同价值。
lessons.example: 同行推出智能客服，本企业先核对客户最常见的服务障碍。
lessons.boundary: 竞争对手的投入金额不是本企业的投资依据。
lessons.quote: 分析竞争变化如何影响客户期待、交付效率和价值链，再决定投资方向。相同工具在不同业务条件下可能产生不同价值。

en.title: Customer need and competitive position
en.body: Examine customer expectations, delivery and value-chain effects rather than copying a competitor's tool choice.
en.example: Investigate service barriers before copying a competitor's chatbot.
en.boundary: A competitor's budget is not your business case.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 价值主张、交付与收益逻辑
lessons.body: 业务模式变化涉及提供何种客户价值、如何交付以及如何获得收益。给现有产品贴AI标签不等于重构业务模式。
lessons.example: 按项目交付咨询转为持续监测服务，需要重新评估定价和运营责任。
lessons.boundary: 新的技术能力必须连接具体付费或价值实现方式。
lessons.quote: 业务模式变化涉及提供何种客户价值、如何交付以及如何获得收益。给现有产品贴AI标签不等于重构业务模式。

en.title: Value proposition, delivery and revenue
en.body: A business model links customer value, delivery and revenue; an AI label alone changes none of these.
en.example: Moving from projects to ongoing monitoring changes pricing and operations.
en.boundary: Connect capabilities to a concrete value-realization mechanism.

en.q: Chapter 2: After deploying a common model, what better supports durable advantage?

wrong: Stop evaluating because the tool is purchased
Increase installation count only

wrong: 立即全企业替换
只参考同行花费

wrong: Replace systems enterprise-wide immediately
Use competitor spending alone

是，只要花同样金额

wrong: Yes; popularity transfers automatically
Yes; match the spending

questions.q: 第2章 · 从项目咨询改持续监测，需要重看什么？

wrong: 仅把名称改成AI
只更换图标
questions.quote: 业务模式变化涉及提供何种客户价值、如何交付以及如何获得收益。给现有产品贴AI标签不等于重构业务模式。

wrong: Only rename it AI
Only change the icon

prompt.zh: 本演练：选择支持持续优势的全部行动。
prompt.en: Exercise: select all actions supporting sustainable advantage.

reason.zh: 反馈、流程和能力互补才形成可持续积累；安装量不证明业务能力。 回看「可持续优势」。
reason.en: Feedback, workflows and capabilities complement one another; installations do not establish business capability. Revisit “Sustainable advantage”.

text.zh: 核验反馈并持续改进流程
text.en: Verify feedback and improve workflows continuously

text.zh: 只统计安装数量并停止学习
text.en: Count installations and stop learning

text.zh: 培养领域人员并将数据用于获授权流程
text.en: Develop domain staff and apply data in authorized workflows

prompt.zh: 本演练：数据基础不稳，董事会规定先完成治理验证再扩展。安排这三个承诺。
prompt.en: Exercise: data foundations are weak; the board requires governance validation before expansion. Order these commitments.

reason.zh: 先补准备再验证再决策，与组织能力和风险承受相匹配；竞争压力不能补齐数据。 回看「投资与成熟度」。
reason.en: Readiness, evidence and staged decisions match capability and risk tolerance; competitive pressure cannot repair data. Revisit “Investment and maturity”.

text.zh: 小范围试点检验价值与风险
text.en: Pilot to test value and risk

text.zh: 依据达标证据决定是否扩展
text.en: Decide whether to scale based on gate evidence

text.zh: 投入数据治理并验证准备
text.en: Fund data governance and validate readiness

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行投入千万，本企业尚未定位客户障碍。选择有证据意识的动作。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor spends ten million; your customer barriers are unknown. Choose an evidence-oriented action.

reason.zh: 竞争变化是调查线索，不是本企业的收益证明；需要自身业务证据。 回看「客户问题与竞争位置」。
reason.en: Competitive change prompts investigation; it does not prove your returns. Local evidence is needed. Revisit “Customer need and competitive position”.

text.zh: 无条件投入更大金额
text.en: Spend more unconditionally

text.zh: 调查客户期待、交付障碍与价值链影响
text.en: Investigate customer expectations, delivery barriers and value-chain effects

text.zh: 假定相同工具产生相同价值
text.en: Assume the same tool gives equal value

prompt.zh: 本演练持续监测服务：将方案条目归入价值、交付、收益。
prompt.en: Exercise continuous monitoring service: classify each proposal component as value, delivery or revenue.

reason.zh: 提醒说明客户所得，维护响应说明如何交付，收费说明价值获取；三者不能用标签代替。 回看「价值主张、交付与收益逻辑」。
reason.en: Alerts define value, maintenance defines delivery and charging defines capture; a label replaces none of them. Revisit “Value proposition, delivery and revenue”.

text.zh: 客户价值
text.en: Customer value

text.zh: 交付方式
text.en: Delivery

text.zh: 收益逻辑
text.en: Revenue

text.zh: 及时获得异常提醒
text.en: Timely exception alerts

text.zh: 团队持续维护与响应
text.en: Team maintains service and responds continuously

text.zh: 按约定服务期收费
text.en: Charge for an agreed service period

sections.title: 互补能力与学习闭环 → 分阶段承诺与停止条件
sections.english: Complementary capabilities and learning → Staged commitments and stop conditions

lessons.title: 互补能力与学习闭环
lessons.body: 可持续优势常来自获授权的数据、嵌入流程、领域经验、客户关系和持续反馈的组合，而不是人人都能购买的同一基础模型。
lessons.example: 积累经核验的维修反馈，并把它用于改进服务流程。
lessons.boundary: 数据多不等于数据独有、可用或有权使用。
lessons.quote: 可持续优势常来自获授权的数据、嵌入流程、领域经验、客户关系和持续反馈的组合，而不是人人都能购买的同一基础模型。

en.title: Complementary capabilities and learning
en.body: Differentiation can come from authorized data, workflows, expertise and feedback rather than a commodity model alone.
en.example: Use verified maintenance feedback to improve service workflows.
en.boundary: More data does not establish exclusivity or permission.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 分阶段承诺与停止条件
lessons.body: 结合行业条件和自身准备度，先验证关键假设，再逐步扩大投入。预先定义价值、质量、风险和成本不达标时的暂停或退出条件。
lessons.example: 先验证获客质量，再决定是否扩展生成内容预算。
lessons.boundary: 试点投入已发生不是继续投入的充分理由。
lessons.quote: 结合行业条件和自身准备度，先验证关键假设，再逐步扩大投入。预先定义价值、质量、风险和成本不达标时的暂停或退出条件。

en.title: Staged commitments and stop conditions
en.body: Stage investment around tested assumptions and define value, quality, risk and cost stop conditions.
en.example: Validate lead quality before expanding a content-generation budget.
en.boundary: Sunk pilot costs alone do not justify more investment.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第2章 · 拥有大量记录是否足以证明持续优势？
questions.a: 否，还需授权、可用性和流程能力等条件
wrong: 是，数量自动产生独占权
是，无需核验数据
questions.quote: 可持续优势常来自获授权的数据、嵌入流程、领域经验、客户关系和持续反馈的组合，而不是人人都能购买的同一基础模型。

en.q: Chapter 2: Do large data holdings alone establish durable advantage?
en.a: No; permission, usability and workflow capability also matter
wrong: Yes; volume automatically grants exclusivity
Yes; no verification needed
en.quote: 可持续优势常来自获授权的数据、嵌入流程、领域经验、客户关系和持续反馈的组合，而不是人人都能购买的同一基础模型。

questions.q: 第2章 · 试点未达质量门槛但已投入很多，应怎么决策？
questions.a: 按预设条件暂停或退出并复核关键假设
wrong: 为追回投入无条件扩展
事后降低门槛宣布成功
questions.quote: 结合行业条件和自身准备度，先验证关键假设，再逐步扩大投入。预先定义价值、质量、风险和成本不达标时的暂停或退出条件。

en.q: Chapter 2: A pilot fails its quality gate after substantial spending. What should happen?
en.a: Pause or exit under the predeclared conditions and review assumptions
wrong: Scale unconditionally to recover spending
Lower the gate after the result and declare success
en.quote: 结合行业条件和自身准备度，先验证关键假设，再逐步扩大投入。预先定义价值、质量、风险和成本不达标时的暂停或退出条件。

brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：选择可用于持续服务改进的全部要素；题设仅a/b已获授权。
prompt.en: Exercise: select all usable elements for continuing service improvement; only a/b have authorization.

reason.zh: 授权数据与领域流程互补；数量不能补上未知来源或使用权。 回看「互补能力与学习闭环」。
reason.en: Authorized data complements domain workflows; volume cannot supply provenance or permission. Revisit “Complementary capabilities and learning”.

text.zh: 获授权且核验的维修反馈
text.en: Authorized, verified maintenance feedback

text.zh: 来源不明的大量客户记录
text.en: Large customer records with unknown provenance

text.zh: 领域团队将反馈嵌入改进流程
text.en: Domain team embeds feedback into improvements

prompt.zh: 本演练预设扩展需质量≥95、月成本≤10万元、风险审查通过。现质量96、成本12、审查通过。选择下一步。
prompt.en: Exercise scaling gates: quality ≥95, monthly cost ≤10, risk review passed. Actual quality 96, cost 12, review passed. Choose.

reason.zh: 成本门槛未达标；其他达标和沉没投入不能替代预先约定的停止条件。 回看「分阶段承诺与停止条件」。
reason.en: The cost gate failed; passing other gates and sunk spending do not replace the predeclared stop condition. Revisit “Staged commitments and stop conditions”.

text.zh: 暂停扩展，核验并改善成本后再评估
text.en: Pause scaling, verify and improve costs, then reassess

text.zh: 事后删除成本门槛
text.en: Delete the cost gate after the result

text.zh: 因试点已花钱立即扩展
text.en: Scale because the pilot already cost money

sections.title: 负责任的AI原则 → 人工监督与升级
sections.english: Responsible AI principles → Human oversight and escalation

lessons.title: 负责任的AI原则
lessons.body: 公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度和稳健性需要进入实际决策与控制，而不仅是口号。不同任务需要相应评估。
lessons.example: 除平均准确率外，也检查不同群体的错误和影响。
lessons.quote: 公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度和稳健性需要进入实际决策与控制，而不仅是口号。不同任务需要相应评估。

en.title: Responsible AI principles
en.body: Fairness, explainability, privacy, security, transparency and robustness should become concrete evaluation and control practices.
en.example: Examine errors across relevant groups as well as overall accuracy.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 目标冲突与取舍
lessons.body: 效率、成本与责任要求可能冲突。把影响、约束和决策责任公开，选择与风险相称的措施并记录理由。
lessons.example: 更快地自动发送高影响决定，不一定比保留人工复核更合适。
lessons.quote: 效率、成本与责任要求可能冲突。把影响、约束和决策责任公开，选择与风险相称的措施并记录理由。

en.title: Competing objectives and trade-offs
en.body: Document conflicts between business objectives and responsibility requirements, affected parties, decision owners and proportionate controls.
en.example: Consider human review before automating a high-impact decision.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 从设计时纳入治理
lessons.body: 在项目规划和设计阶段确定数据用途、责任、验证与监督，避免上线后才补救关键问题。
lessons.example: 选数据之前就讨论访问权限和允许用途。
lessons.quote: 在项目规划和设计阶段确定数据用途、责任、验证与监督，避免上线后才补救关键问题。

en.title: Governance by design
en.body: Define intended use, data responsibilities, evaluation and oversight during planning and design, before deployment.
en.example: Review permitted data use before selecting a dataset.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 人工监督与升级
lessons.body: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。
lessons.example: 出现缺乏来源的重要结论时，交给有责任的人员核验。
lessons.quote: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。

en.title: Human oversight and escalation
en.body: Specify when people review, stop or take over an AI process and who has decision authority.
en.example: Escalate an important unsupported claim for authorized verification.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第3章 · 团队声称遵循稳健性原则，哪项证据最直接支持此声明？

Confident model wording

wrong: Only time saved
Only that everyone agreed

en.q: Chapter 3: When should a project in feature design define data use and oversight ownership?

After every feature is frozen

questions.q: 第3章 · 演练中模型说“我确信可以恢复”，但只有审批员有恢复权限。应该怎么做？

questions.quote: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。

Let the model grant itself authority
en.quote: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。

prompt.en: The team has only a principles poster. Select every addition that produces actual assessment or control evidence.

reason.zh: 分组差错评估和异常条件测试让原则进入实际验证；仅改宣传措辞不能证明控制有效。 常见错误：有原则海报就等于已治理。 回看《负责任的AI原则》。
reason.en: Subgroup error assessment and abnormal-condition tests operationalize principles; promotional wording does not demonstrate effective controls. Common error: A principles poster is treated as implemented governance. Review “Responsible AI principles”.

text.zh: 记录相关群体的差错并评审
text.en: Record and review errors for relevant groups

text.zh: 在异常输入下测试并记录结果
text.en: Test abnormal inputs and record results

text.zh: 把海报换成更醒目的颜色
text.en: Change the poster to brighter colors

prompt.zh: 演练给定：预算3；必须做影响记录和责任确认；总控制值至少3。选择满足全部约束的工作包。分值只用于本题。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 3; impact recording and owner confirmation are mandatory; total control value must reach 3. Select a feasible package. Scores apply only here.

reason.zh: 影响记录和责任确认各占1预算，风险控制占1，恰好达到3；纯加速项不满足责任硬约束。取舍需记录理由。 常见错误：以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。 回看《目标冲突与取舍》。
reason.en: Impact recording, owner confirmation and risk control each cost 1 and jointly reach 3. Acceleration alone misses mandatory responsibility constraints. Record the trade-off rationale. Common error: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership. Review “Competing objectives and trade-offs”.

text.zh: 记录影响：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Record impact: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 确认决策责任：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Confirm decision owner: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 风险相称控制：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Proportionate control: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 仅提速：成本3，控制值0
text.en: Acceleration only: cost 3, control value 0

prompt.zh: 演练项目规定：先确定用途与责任，再设计验证和监督，通过验证后才上线。按这三道门排序。
prompt.en: Case policy: establish use and ownership, design evaluation and oversight, then deploy only after validation. Order these three gates.

reason.zh: 用途与责任约束验证和监督设计；通过这些验证才进入发布。把治理留到上线后会错过设计阶段的控制机会。 常见错误：上线后补监督与验证即可。 回看《从设计时纳入治理》。
reason.en: Use and ownership guide evaluation and oversight; deployment follows successful validation. Delaying governance misses design-stage controls. Common error: Oversight and validation can simply be added after launch. Review “Governance by design”.

text.zh: 设计监督并完成验证
text.en: Design oversight and complete validation

text.zh: 通过验证后上线
text.en: Deploy after validation passes

text.zh: 确定数据用途与责任
text.en: Define data use and ownership

prompt.zh: 演练授权：监控员可暂停自动行动；审批员可决定恢复；模型无任何授权。勾选且仅勾选获授权的组合。
prompt.en: Exercise authority: monitor may pause automation; approver may authorize resumption; model has no authority. Select exactly the authorized combinations.

reason.zh: 停止与恢复是不同授权，按给定角色分配；模型无论措辞多自信都不能自行获得权限。 常见错误：模型自信表达等于正式授权。 回看《人工监督与升级》。
reason.en: Stopping and resumption are separate authorizations assigned by the case; confidence does not grant the model authority. Common error: Confident model language counts as formal authorization. Review “Human oversight and escalation”.

text.zh: 监控员
text.en: Monitor

text.zh: 审批员
text.en: Approver

text.zh: 模型
text.en: Model

text.zh: 暂停
text.en: Pause

text.zh: 批准恢复
text.en: Approve resumption

sections.title: 公平性与分组表现 → 收益、影响与比例原则
sections.english: Fairness and subgroup outcomes → Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls

lessons.title: 公平性与分组表现
lessons.body: 公平性评估要结合具体用途和受影响群体，检查差错、机会和影响的差异。总体平均指标不能替代相关群体评估，目标之间也可能存在取舍。
lessons.example: 总体错误率低，但某地区用户频繁受损，需要单独调查。
lessons.boundary: 不存在脱离用途、适用于一切情境的单一公平指标。
lessons.quote: 公平性评估要结合具体用途和受影响群体，检查差错、机会和影响的差异。总体平均指标不能替代相关群体评估，目标之间也可能存在取舍。

en.title: Fairness and subgroup outcomes
en.body: Assess relevant groups and impacts for the use case; overall averages cannot substitute for subgroup evaluation.
en.example: Investigate a region with disproportionately harmful errors.
en.boundary: No single fairness metric fits every context.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 可说明性与透明度
lessons.body: 可说明性帮助理解系统行为或判断依据；透明度使相关人员了解AI参与、适用边界和重要限制，以便作出知情选择。
lessons.example: 告知客户使用AI，并提供可理解的判断依据和申诉渠道。
lessons.boundary: 展示技术术语不等于给出可用解释。
lessons.quote: 可说明性帮助理解系统行为或判断依据；透明度使相关人员了解AI参与、适用边界和重要限制，以便作出知情选择。

en.title: Explainability and transparency
en.body: Explainability supports understanding behavior; transparency supports informed choices about AI use and its limits.
en.example: Disclose AI use and provide understandable grounds and recourse.
en.boundary: Technical jargon is not necessarily a useful explanation.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 隐私、安全与稳健性
lessons.body: 隐私关注个人资料的适当使用与保护；安全关注防止未授权访问或破坏；稳健性关注系统在合理变化和异常条件下仍能适当运行。
lessons.example: 检查访问权限，限制敏感数据，并测试异常输入。
lessons.boundary: 这些维度相关但不能互相替代。
lessons.quote: 隐私关注个人资料的适当使用与保护；安全关注防止未授权访问或破坏；稳健性关注系统在合理变化和异常条件下仍能适当运行。

en.title: Privacy, security and robustness
en.body: Privacy concerns appropriate personal-data use; security concerns unauthorized access or harm; robustness concerns behavior under changing conditions.
en.example: Enforce access, limit sensitive data and test abnormal inputs.
en.boundary: These dimensions overlap but do not replace one another.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 收益、影响与比例原则
lessons.body: 讨论效率收益时同时说明受影响对象、损害可能性、严重程度和可逆性。选择与影响相称的控制，并记录取舍和决定责任。
lessons.example: 高影响决定保留有效人工复核，而非只追求自动处理率。
lessons.boundary: 业务指标提高不能自动抵消对个人的严重损害。
lessons.quote: 讨论效率收益时同时说明受影响对象、损害可能性、严重程度和可逆性。选择与影响相称的控制，并记录取舍和决定责任。

en.title: Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls
en.body: Assess affected parties, likelihood, severity and reversibility when balancing benefits and controls.
en.example: Retain meaningful human review for high-impact decisions.
en.boundary: Business improvement does not automatically offset serious harm.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第3章 · 两组错误差异很大，但总体指标达标。合理结论是什么？
questions.a: 仍需结合用途评估群体影响与取舍
wrong: 总体达标即证明公平
只看样本最多的一组
questions.quote: 公平性评估要结合具体用途和受影响群体，检查差错、机会和影响的差异。总体平均指标不能替代相关群体评估，目标之间也可能存在取舍。

questions.q: 第3章 · 页面只写“本服务使用AI”，还缺什么才能帮助理解一次建议？

隐去适用边界

Hide the usage boundaries
en.quote: 可说明性帮助理解系统行为或判断依据；透明度使相关人员了解AI参与、适用边界和重要限制，以便作出知情选择。

questions.q: 第3章 · 系统限制了账号访问，但从未测试环境变化。哪项仍缺证据？
questions.a: 稳健性
wrong: 已经证明全部责任原则
仅因有密码即可证明稳健
questions.quote: 隐私关注个人资料的适当使用与保护；安全关注防止未授权访问或破坏；稳健性关注系统在合理变化和异常条件下仍能适当运行。

en.q: Chapter 3: Accounts are access-controlled, but changing conditions were never tested. What still lacks evidence?
en.a: Robustness
wrong: Every responsibility principle is proven
A password already proves robustness
en.quote: 隐私关注个人资料的适当使用与保护；安全关注防止未授权访问或破坏；稳健性关注系统在合理变化和异常条件下仍能适当运行。

questions.q: 第3章 · 两种用途收益相同，其中一种损害难以逆转。评审应如何处理？
questions.a: 将可逆性纳入相称控制和取舍记录
wrong: 收益相同所以控制必须相同
忽略损害只比较速度
questions.quote: 讨论效率收益时同时说明受影响对象、损害可能性、严重程度和可逆性。选择与影响相称的控制，并记录取舍和决定责任。

en.q: Chapter 3: Two uses have equal benefits, but harm from one is hard to reverse. What should the review do?
en.a: Include reversibility in proportionate controls and the trade-off record
wrong: Equal benefits require identical controls
Ignore harm and compare only speed
en.quote: 讨论效率收益时同时说明受影响对象、损害可能性、严重程度和可逆性。选择与影响相称的控制，并记录取舍和决定责任。

title.zh: 公平性与分组表现 → 收益、影响与比例原则

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练：总体错误率5%，但未按受影响群体统计。选择所有必要的下一步；本题不设普遍公平阈值。
prompt.en: Exercise: overall error rate is 5%, with no breakdown for affected groups. Select all necessary next steps; no universal fairness threshold is given.

reason.zh: 需要识别相关群体、比较差错和影响，并讨论取舍；一个总体均值不能给出群体分布。 常见错误：总体平均优秀足以证明公平。 回看《公平性与分组表现》。
reason.en: Identify relevant groups, compare errors and impacts, and discuss trade-offs; an aggregate average cannot reveal group distributions. Common error: A strong overall average proves fairness. Review “Fairness and subgroup outcomes”.

text.zh: 比较群体差错、机会和影响
text.en: Compare group errors, opportunities and impacts

text.zh: 直接宣布不存在公平性问题
text.en: Declare no fairness issue immediately

text.zh: 结合用途识别相关群体
text.en: Identify relevant groups for the use

prompt.zh: 给交付物分类：解释判断依据放入可说明性；披露AI参与及边界放入透明度。
prompt.en: Classify deliverables: decision-basis explanations support explainability; disclosure of AI involvement and limits supports transparency.

reason.zh: 依据说明帮助理解行为；参与和限制披露帮助知情选择，两者不能互相替代。 常见错误：披露AI参与等同于解释每次判断。 回看《可说明性与透明度》。
reason.en: Explaining the basis supports understanding behavior; disclosing participation and limits supports informed choice. Neither substitutes for the other. Common error: Disclosing AI involvement explains each decision. Review “Explainability and transparency”.

text.zh: 可说明性
text.en: Explainability

text.zh: 透明度
text.en: Transparency

text.zh: 说明本次建议使用哪些判断依据
text.en: Explain the basis of this recommendation

text.zh: 告知用户AI参与及重要限制
text.en: Tell users about AI participation and key limits

prompt.zh: 将三个独立检查路由到最直接的目的；这里按题面关注点分类。
prompt.en: Route three checks by their most direct purpose, using the stated focus.

reason.zh: 资料用途关注隐私，阻止未授权访问关注安全，变化条件下表现关注稳健性。控制可能互补，但目的有区别。 常见错误：有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。 回看《隐私、安全与稳健性》。
reason.en: Appropriate data use concerns privacy, unauthorized access concerns security, and behavior under change concerns robustness. Controls can complement one another but have distinct purposes. Common error: A password resolves privacy and robustness too. Review “Privacy, security and robustness”.

text.zh: 隐私
text.en: Privacy

text.zh: 安全
text.en: Security

text.zh: 稳健性
text.en: Robustness

text.zh: 检查个人资料是否用于适当目的
text.en: Check appropriate personal-data purposes

text.zh: 阻止无权限账号进入资料库
text.en: Block unauthorized accounts from the repository

text.zh: 测试输入异常时能否适当运行
text.en: Test appropriate behavior on unusual inputs

prompt.zh: 评审已记录节省时间。选择还应补充的全部信息，以讨论相称控制。
prompt.en: The review records time savings. Select every missing input needed to discuss proportionate controls.

reason.zh: 影响对象、可能性、严重程度、可逆性和决定责任共同支持取舍；厂商品牌不提供这些影响证据。 常见错误：只记录收益，不记录损害严重性和可逆性。 回看《收益、影响与比例原则》。
reason.en: Affected people, likelihood, severity, reversibility and decision ownership support the trade-off; a vendor brand provides none of this impact evidence. Common error: Benefits are recorded while severity and reversibility are omitted. Review “Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls”.

text.zh: 受影响对象及损害可能性
text.en: Affected people and likelihood of harm

text.zh: 严重程度与可逆性
text.en: Severity and reversibility

text.zh: 控制取舍和决定责任
text.en: Control trade-offs and decision ownership

text.zh: 只补模型品牌
text.en: Add only the model brand

sections.title: 从用途定义开始设置保障 → 合规风险识别
sections.english: Safeguards from use-case definition → Compliance risk identification

lessons.title: 从用途定义开始设置保障
lessons.body: 在选择数据、设计功能和定义验收标准时纳入责任要求，识别不允许的用途和需要人工介入的情形，再迭代验证。
lessons.example: 设计客服检索时就实施权限，而不是上线后只加免责声明。
lessons.boundary: 设计时治理不意味着不允许小范围迭代。
lessons.quote: 在选择数据、设计功能和定义验收标准时纳入责任要求，识别不允许的用途和需要人工介入的情形，再迭代验证。

en.title: Safeguards from use-case definition
en.body: Define permitted uses, safeguards and review conditions during data and feature design, then test them.
en.example: Implement retrieval permissions during design, not just a later notice.
en.boundary: Governance by design can coexist with controlled iteration.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 复核能力与升级阈值
lessons.body: 监督者需要证据、时间、训练和停止或修改行动的权限。为无来源结论、异常指标和高影响操作定义升级条件与接手者。
lessons.example: 不能核验的重要结论转给负责人，不能只要求点击确认。
lessons.boundary: 有人工按钮不代表已经形成有效监督。
lessons.quote: 监督者需要证据、时间、训练和停止或修改行动的权限。为无来源结论、异常指标和高影响操作定义升级条件与接手者。

en.title: Review capability and escalation triggers
en.body: Reviewers need evidence, time, training and authority; define escalation triggers and owners.
en.example: Escalate an important unsupported result rather than requesting ceremonial approval.
en.boundary: A human button alone is not meaningful oversight.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 跨职能治理与问责
lessons.body: 业务、技术、数据、法务及合规等角色共同参与，并明确谁负责哪些决策。多人参与不代表责任可以模糊。
lessons.example: 明确谁批准用途、谁维护资料、谁处理异常。
lessons.quote: 业务、技术、数据、法务及合规等角色共同参与，并明确谁负责哪些决策。多人参与不代表责任可以模糊。

en.title: Cross-functional governance and accountability
en.body: Include business, technical, data and relevant oversight roles with explicit decision responsibilities.
en.example: Assign owners for use approval, source maintenance and incident handling.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 合规风险识别
lessons.body: 先确定业务用途、数据类型、适用地区与组织要求，再由相关责任人评估合规风险。通用清单不能代替具体判断。
lessons.example: 新用途涉及个人资料时，应先进行适用要求与授权核对。
lessons.quote: 先确定业务用途、数据类型、适用地区与组织要求，再由相关责任人评估合规风险。通用清单不能代替具体判断。

en.title: Compliance risk identification
en.body: Determine intended use, data types, jurisdictions and applicable organizational requirements before evaluating compliance risks.
en.example: Consult the responsible specialists before reusing personal information.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第3章 · 设计验收标准时发现高影响操作需要人工介入，应该如何处理？
questions.a: 把介入情形和保障纳入设计及验证
wrong: 只测响应速度
等上线后用户投诉才定义介入
questions.quote: 在选择数据、设计功能和定义验收标准时纳入责任要求，识别不允许的用途和需要人工介入的情形，再迭代验证。
questions.topic: Task 3.3 · 从用途定义开始设置保障 → 合规风险识别

en.q: Chapter 3: During acceptance design, a high-impact action needs human intervention. What should happen?

wrong: Test only response speed
Define intervention only after complaints

questions.q: 第3章 · 出现无来源的重要结论，复核员没有停止权。最直接的治理缺口是什么？
questions.a: 监督缺少实际权限与明确升级接手
wrong: 复核员签名不够漂亮
模型措辞不够确定
questions.quote: 监督者需要证据、时间、训练和停止或修改行动的权限。为无来源结论、异常指标和高影响操作定义升级条件与接手者。
questions.topic: Task 3.3 · 从用途定义开始设置保障 → 合规风险识别

en.q: Chapter 3: An important unsupported conclusion appears and the reviewer cannot stop action. What is the direct governance gap?
en.a: Oversight lacks practical authority and a defined escalation owner
wrong: The signature is unattractive
The model wording lacks certainty
en.quote: 监督者需要证据、时间、训练和停止或修改行动的权限。为无来源结论、异常指标和高影响操作定义升级条件与接手者。

questions.q: 第3章 · 五个部门参加评审，但无人有权作上线决定。还缺什么？
questions.a: 明确该决定的责任与授权边界
wrong: 再增加参会人数
把责任写为所有人共同承担即可
questions.quote: 业务、技术、数据、法务及合规等角色共同参与，并明确谁负责哪些决策。多人参与不代表责任可以模糊。
questions.topic: Task 3.3 · 从用途定义开始设置保障 → 合规风险识别

en.q: Chapter 3: Five departments attend a review, but nobody may decide deployment. What is missing?
en.a: Explicit ownership and authority for that decision
wrong: More attendees
Simply assign responsibility to everyone
en.quote: 业务、技术、数据、法务及合规等角色共同参与，并明确谁负责哪些决策。多人参与不代表责任可以模糊。

questions.q: 第3章 · 团队只凭通用清单宣布合规，资料类型和地区仍未知。合理下一步？
questions.a: 补充上下文并交相关责任人评估
wrong: 继续使用该结论
让模型口头保证合法
questions.quote: 先确定业务用途、数据类型、适用地区与组织要求，再由相关责任人评估合规风险。通用清单不能代替具体判断。
questions.topic: Task 3.3 · 从用途定义开始设置保障 → 合规风险识别

en.q: Chapter 3: A generic checklist is used to declare compliance while data types and locations are unknown. What next?
en.a: Complete context and ask responsible people to assess it
wrong: Keep the conclusion
Ask the model for a verbal legality guarantee
en.quote: 先确定业务用途、数据类型、适用地区与组织要求，再由相关责任人评估合规风险。通用清单不能代替具体判断。

title.zh: 从用途定义开始设置保障 → 合规风险识别
title.en: Safeguards from use-case definition → Compliance risk identification

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练规定按用途定义→保障设计→验证迭代推进。将步骤排序。
prompt.en: Case workflow requires use definition, safeguard design, then iterative validation. Order the steps.

reason.zh: 先界定允许和不允许用途，再设置数据、功能和人工介入保障，最后以这些要求验证并迭代。 常见错误：先做功能，验收时只测速度。 回看《从用途定义开始设置保障》。
reason.en: Define permitted and prohibited uses, then design data, feature and human-intervention safeguards, and validate against those requirements. Common error: Build features first and test only speed at acceptance. Review “Safeguards from use-case definition”.

text.zh: 设计资料、功能及人工介入保障
text.en: Design data, feature and human-review safeguards

text.zh: 纳入验收并迭代验证
text.en: Include safeguards in acceptance and iterate tests

text.zh: 定义用途与禁止场景
text.en: Define intended and prohibited uses

prompt.zh: 演练：复核员只能看到结论，必须立即签字且无暂停权。选择所有必要补强。
prompt.en: Case: a reviewer sees only conclusions, must sign immediately, and cannot pause actions. Select all necessary improvements.

reason.zh: 监督需要证据、时间、训练、停止或修改权，并给无来源结论等触发事件指定接手人；单纯签字不提供能力。 常见错误：安排一个签字人即可构成有效监督。 回看《复核能力与升级阈值》。
reason.en: Oversight needs evidence, time, training, stop or modification authority, and owners for triggers such as unsupported conclusions. A signature alone provides no capability. Common error: Assigning a signer creates effective oversight. Review “Review capability and escalation triggers”.

text.zh: 只增加签字次数
text.en: Only require more signatures

text.zh: 提供证据、复核时间和训练
text.en: Provide evidence, review time and training

text.zh: 定义无来源结论等升级条件与接手者
text.en: Define unsupported-claim escalation and takeover owners

text.zh: 授予停止或修改权限
text.en: Grant stop or modification authority

prompt.zh: 演练分工：业务负责人决定用途；技术负责人决定部署配置；合规负责人核对组织要求。仅标记指定职责，不推断其他权限。
prompt.en: Case assignments: business owner decides use; technical owner decides deployment settings; compliance owner checks organizational requirements. Mark only these duties.

reason.zh: 跨职能参与与清晰决策责任同时成立；参会不自动赋予所有人全部决策权。 常见错误：所有部门参会就无需指定责任人。 回看《跨职能治理与问责》。
reason.en: Cross-functional participation coexists with clear decision ownership; attendance does not grant everyone every authority. Common error: Attendance by every department removes the need for owners. Review “Cross-functional governance and accountability”.

text.zh: 业务负责人
text.en: Business owner

text.zh: 技术负责人
text.en: Technical owner

text.zh: 合规负责人
text.en: Compliance owner

text.zh: 用途决定
text.en: Use decision

text.zh: 部署配置
text.en: Deployment settings

text.zh: 核对组织要求
text.en: Check organizational requirements

prompt.zh: 演练项目尚未说明地区或资料类别。选择提交责任人评估前应补充的全部上下文。
prompt.en: The case omits locations and data categories. Select every context item needed before assessment by responsible people.

reason.zh: 用途、数据、地区与组织要求决定核查上下文；清单只能辅助，不能凭未知条件直接宣告合规。 常见错误：通用清单可以直接给出所有用途的合规结论。 回看《合规风险识别》。
reason.en: Use, data, locations and organizational requirements establish assessment context; a checklist cannot justify a compliance conclusion with unknown conditions. Common error: A generic checklist determines compliance for every use. Review “Compliance risk identification”.

text.zh: 只提交“通用清单已勾完”
text.en: Submit only a completed generic checklist

text.zh: 业务用途和数据类型
text.en: Intended business use and data types

text.zh: 适用地区和组织要求
text.en: Relevant locations and organizational requirements

sections.title: 访问控制与数据安全 → 用途、资料与适用要求
sections.english: Access control and data security → Use, data and applicable requirements

lessons.title: 访问控制与数据安全
lessons.body: 只授予完成工作所需的访问与操作权限，并在资料和工具层执行控制。仅靠提示词不能可靠替代权限系统。
lessons.example: 无权读取人事档案的员工，不应通过检索助手得到档案内容。
lessons.quote: 只授予完成工作所需的访问与操作权限，并在资料和工具层执行控制。仅靠提示词不能可靠替代权限系统。

en.title: Access control and data security
en.body: Grant only necessary permissions and enforce them in data and tool systems; prompts alone cannot implement reliable access control.
en.example: A retrieval assistant must not expose personnel files to unauthorized users.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: AI风险分类
lessons.body: 结合用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制条件分类风险，再安排评估与治理优先级；不要仅按模型大小分类。
lessons.example: 内部草稿辅助与影响个人重要权益的自动决定，需要不同控制。
lessons.quote: 结合用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制条件分类风险，再安排评估与治理优先级；不要仅按模型大小分类。

en.title: AI risk classification
en.body: Classify a use case by potential impact, affected parties and controls to prioritize oversight.
en.example: An internal drafting aid and a consequential automated decision need different controls.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 负责执行与最终问责
lessons.body: 执行者完成工作，最终问责者对决定和结果负责。业务、技术、数据和监督职能需要明确协作与授权边界，避免多人参与却无人作决定。
lessons.example: 业务负责人批准用途，数据负责人维护资料，运维负责告警。
lessons.boundary: 供应商负责模型服务，不等于替客户承担全部业务决定。
lessons.quote: 执行者完成工作，最终问责者对决定和结果负责。业务、技术、数据和监督职能需要明确协作与授权边界，避免多人参与却无人作决定。

en.title: Responsible versus accountable
en.body: Distinguish doing the work from owning a decision; define cross-functional authority and handoffs.
en.example: Business approves use, data owners maintain sources, and operations handle alerts.
en.boundary: A supplier does not own all customer use decisions.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 用途、资料与适用要求
lessons.body: 合规识别需要知道系统用途、受影响人群、数据类别、使用地区及组织要求，再由有责任的专业人员核对适用条件。
lessons.example: 内部文稿辅助改为影响客户权益的自动决定，需要重新评估。
lessons.boundary: 通用清单不能替代针对具体用途的判断。
lessons.quote: 合规识别需要知道系统用途、受影响人群、数据类别、使用地区及组织要求，再由有责任的专业人员核对适用条件。

en.title: Use, data and applicable requirements
en.body: Assess intended use, people, data, location and organizational requirements with responsible specialists.
en.example: Reassess when a drafting aid becomes a consequential decision system.
en.boundary: A generic checklist is not a use-specific determination.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第3章 · 客服任务只需FAQ，但工具拥有账单读取权。应该改哪里？
questions.a: 在资料和工具层撤销不必要权限
wrong: 仅添加“请勿读账单”的提示
保留权限并让模型承诺
questions.quote: 只授予完成工作所需的访问与操作权限，并在资料和工具层执行控制。仅靠提示词不能可靠替代权限系统。
questions.topic: Task 3.4 · 访问控制与数据安全 → 用途、资料与适用要求

en.q: Chapter 3: Support only needs FAQs, but its tool can read invoices. What should change?
en.a: Revoke unnecessary access in data and tool systems
wrong: Only prompt it not to read invoices
Keep access and ask for a promise
en.quote: 只授予完成工作所需的访问与操作权限，并在资料和工具层执行控制。仅靠提示词不能可靠替代权限系统。

questions.q: 第3章 · 小模型参与高影响决定，大模型用于低影响草稿。能否仅凭规模给小模型低优先级？
questions.a: 不能，应结合用途、损害和控制评估
wrong: 能，规模是唯一标准
能，只要小模型速度快
questions.quote: 结合用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制条件分类风险，再安排评估与治理优先级；不要仅按模型大小分类。
questions.topic: Task 3.4 · 访问控制与数据安全 → 用途、资料与适用要求

en.q: Chapter 3: A small model supports a high-impact decision; a large model drafts low-impact text. Can size alone lower the small model’s priority?
en.a: No; assess use, harm and controls
wrong: Yes; size is the sole criterion
Yes if the small model is fast
en.quote: 结合用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制条件分类风险，再安排评估与治理优先级；不要仅按模型大小分类。

questions.q: 第3章 · 分析员完成验证，按演练业务主管最终问责。谁作最终上线决定？
questions.a: 业务主管
wrong: 分析员因为做了验证
无需任何人决定
questions.quote: 执行者完成工作，最终问责者对决定和结果负责。业务、技术、数据和监督职能需要明确协作与授权边界，避免多人参与却无人作决定。
questions.topic: Task 3.4 · 访问控制与数据安全 → 用途、资料与适用要求

en.q: Chapter 3: The analyst validates; the business lead is accountable under the case. Who makes the final deployment decision?
en.a: Business lead
wrong: Analyst because they ran validation
Nobody needs to decide
en.quote: 执行者完成工作，最终问责者对决定和结果负责。业务、技术、数据和监督职能需要明确协作与授权边界，避免多人参与却无人作决定。

questions.q: 第3章 · 资料表已有数据类别却没有使用地区。交专业人员前应如何做？
questions.a: 补充使用地区及其他缺失上下文
wrong: 按任意地区规则宣告合规
把未知地区留空并默认无要求
questions.quote: 合规识别需要知道系统用途、受影响人群、数据类别、使用地区及组织要求，再由有责任的专业人员核对适用条件。
questions.topic: Task 3.4 · 访问控制与数据安全 → 用途、资料与适用要求

en.q: Chapter 3: The context sheet lists data categories but omits usage locations. What should happen before specialist review?
en.a: Add locations and other missing context
wrong: Declare compliance under an arbitrary location’s rules
Leave locations blank and assume no requirements
en.quote: 合规识别需要知道系统用途、受影响人群、数据类别、使用地区及组织要求，再由有责任的专业人员核对适用条件。

title.zh: 访问控制与数据安全 → 用途、资料与适用要求
title.en: Access control and data security → Use, data and applicable requirements

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练：客服只需读FAQ；财务只需读账单；两者均不需删除。配置最小权限，列为读FAQ、读账单、删除。
prompt.en: Case: support needs FAQ reads only; finance needs invoice reads only; neither needs deletion. Configure least privilege across FAQ read, invoice read and delete.

reason.zh: 只开放任务所需读取权限，删除无必要。矩阵必须在资料和工具系统执行，不能仅写在提示词里。 常见错误：提示词写“不要越权”就能替代工具权限。 回看《访问控制与数据安全》。
reason.en: Grant only the required reads and no deletion. Enforce the matrix in data and tool systems, not merely in prompts. Common error: A prompt saying not to exceed authority replaces tool permissions. Review “Access control and data security”.

text.zh: 客服
text.en: Support

text.zh: 财务
text.en: Finance

text.zh: 读FAQ
text.en: Read FAQ

text.zh: 读账单
text.en: Read invoices

text.zh: 删除
text.en: Delete

prompt.zh: 为两个模型的用途排治理优先级。选择应比较的全部依据，不直接推断风险等级。
prompt.en: Prioritize governance for two model uses. Select all relevant comparison inputs without assigning an unsupported risk grade.

reason.zh: 用途、对象、损害和控制条件支持影响判断；只凭参数大小不能确定用途风险。 常见错误：模型越大风险一定越高。 回看《AI风险分类》。
reason.en: Use, affected people, harm and controls support impact assessment; parameter count alone cannot determine use-case risk. Common error: Larger models are always higher risk. Review “AI risk classification”.

text.zh: 用途与受影响对象
text.en: Use and affected people

text.zh: 只按模型大小决定等级
text.en: Determine grades solely by model size

text.zh: 潜在损害与现有控制
text.en: Potential harm and current controls

prompt.zh: 演练授权：分析员执行验证；业务主管最终决定是否上线。仅选择这两个对应职责。
prompt.en: Case authority: analyst performs validation; business lead owns the final deployment decision. Select only those two assignments.

reason.zh: 执行者提供工作结果，问责者对决定和结果负责。两种职责按明确授权划分，不能因参与工作就推断决策权。 常见错误：负责执行的人必然拥有最终决策权。 回看《负责执行与最终问责》。
reason.en: The executor provides the work; the accountable owner owns the decision and outcome. Explicit authority separates the roles; participation does not imply decision power. Common error: The person doing the work necessarily owns the decision. Review “Responsible versus accountable”.

text.zh: 分析员
text.en: Analyst

text.zh: 业务主管
text.en: Business lead

text.zh: 执行验证
text.en: Perform validation

text.zh: 最终上线决定
text.en: Final deployment decision

prompt.zh: 演练评审流程固定为：先收集用途与人群，再补数据、地区和组织要求，最后由责任专业人员核对。按流程排序。
prompt.en: The case fixes this review workflow: collect use and people, complete data/location/organizational context, then responsible specialists check applicability. Order it.

reason.zh: 专业人员需要完整上下文才能核对适用条件；这里的顺序来自演练交接要求，不是通用法律程序。 常见错误：把使用地区或受影响人群省略也不影响具体核查。 回看《用途、资料与适用要求》。
reason.en: Specialists need the full context to check applicable conditions. This ordering is a case handoff requirement, not a universal legal procedure. Common error: Omitting locations or affected people does not affect assessment. Review “Use, data and applicable requirements”.

text.zh: 补充数据类别、地区与组织要求
text.en: Complete data categories, locations and organizational requirements

text.zh: 责任专业人员核对适用条件
text.en: Responsible specialists check applicable conditions

text.zh: 收集用途与受影响人群
text.en: Collect use and affected people

sections.title: 最小权限与检索前过滤 → 生命周期中的偏差
sections.english: Least privilege and pre-retrieval filtering → Bias across the lifecycle

lessons.title: 最小权限与检索前过滤
lessons.body: 只授予工作所需的数据与工具权限，在检索或执行前验证身份和授权。输出后再遮盖，不能代替阻止越权检索。
lessons.example: 客服可读获准政策，不能读人事档案，也不能自行批准高额退款。
lessons.boundary: 提示层拒绝不构成可靠权限边界。
lessons.quote: 只授予工作所需的数据与工具权限，在检索或执行前验证身份和授权。输出后再遮盖，不能代替阻止越权检索。

en.title: Least privilege and pre-retrieval filtering
en.body: Authorize identities and data or tools before retrieval and execution; grant only needed access.
en.example: Support may read policy but not personnel records or approve large refunds.
en.boundary: A model refusal is not a reliable access boundary.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 按影响分配治理力度
lessons.body: 以用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制情况确定评估优先级，生命周期中用途或环境改变时重新分级。模型规模不是唯一风险标准。
lessons.example: 内部摘要与自动影响个人权益的决策需要不同审查力度。
lessons.boundary: 风险分级不是一次立项表格。
lessons.quote: 以用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制情况确定评估优先级，生命周期中用途或环境改变时重新分级。模型规模不是唯一风险标准。

en.title: Risk-proportionate governance
en.body: Prioritize by use, affected people, harm and controls, and reassess when conditions change.
en.example: Internal summaries and consequential decisions need different scrutiny.
en.boundary: Risk classification is not a one-time form.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 生产监控与事件处理
lessons.body: 为运行质量、日志、异常处理、人工升级和回退设定机制。控制要在上线后持续发挥作用。
lessons.example: 错误率突然升高时限制受影响用途，再调查原因。
lessons.quote: 为运行质量、日志、异常处理、人工升级和回退设定机制。控制要在上线后持续发挥作用。

en.title: Production monitoring and incidents
en.body: Operate logging, quality checks, escalation, fallback and incident response throughout deployment.
en.example: Restrict an affected use when error rates rise, then investigate.

lessons.title: 生命周期中的偏差
lessons.body: 偏差可能来自采样、标注、训练目标和部署环境等阶段。持续观察分组表现及环境变化，不把一次检查当作永久结论。
lessons.example: 整体分数稳定时，某一群体的错误仍可能增加。
lessons.quote: 偏差可能来自采样、标注、训练目标和部署环境等阶段。持续观察分组表现及环境变化，不把一次检查当作永久结论。

en.title: Bias across the lifecycle
en.body: Sampling, labeling, objectives and deployment context can introduce bias; evaluate relevant subgroup outcomes over time.
en.example: A stable average score may hide worsening performance for one group.
