questions.q: 第3章 · 检索器读取了禁止资料后才遮盖答案，这是否替代检索前授权？
questions.a: 不能，越权检索已经发生
wrong: 可以，只要用户没看到
可以，只要提示词要求保密
questions.quote: 只授予工作所需的数据与工具权限，在检索或执行前验证身份和授权。输出后再遮盖，不能代替阻止越权检索。
questions.topic: Task 3.5 · 最小权限与检索前过滤 → 生命周期中的偏差

en.q: Chapter 3: The retriever reads forbidden data and then masks the answer. Does this replace authorization before retrieval?
en.a: No; unauthorized retrieval already happened
wrong: Yes if the user never sees it
Yes if the prompt asks for secrecy
en.quote: 只授予工作所需的数据与工具权限，在检索或执行前验证身份和授权。输出后再遮盖，不能代替阻止越权检索。

questions.q: 第3章 · 模型版本未变，但部署人群与用途改变。应如何处理风险等级？
questions.a: 按新影响条件重新评估
wrong: 永久保留旧等级
仅比较模型参数数量
questions.quote: 以用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制情况确定评估优先级，生命周期中用途或环境改变时重新分级。模型规模不是唯一风险标准。
questions.topic: Task 3.5 · 最小权限与检索前过滤 → 生命周期中的偏差

en.q: Chapter 3: The model version is unchanged but use and deployment population change. What about its risk grade?
en.a: Reassess under the new impact conditions
wrong: Keep the old grade permanently
Compare only parameter counts
en.quote: 以用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制情况确定评估优先级，生命周期中用途或环境改变时重新分级。模型规模不是唯一风险标准。

questions.q: 第3章 · 上线前通过测试，但运行中出现异常。合理机制应包括什么？
questions.a: 日志追踪、异常处理、人工升级与回退
wrong: 只引用上线前测试证明安全
删除异常日志避免告警
questions.quote: 为运行质量、日志、异常处理、人工升级和回退设定机制。控制要在上线后持续发挥作用。
questions.topic: Task 3.5 · 最小权限与检索前过滤 → 生命周期中的偏差

en.q: Chapter 3: Pre-launch tests passed, but an anomaly appears in operation. What mechanisms are appropriate?
en.a: Traceable logs, incident handling, human escalation and fallback
wrong: Use pre-launch tests as permanent safety proof
Delete anomalous logs to avoid alerts
en.quote: 为运行质量、日志、异常处理、人工升级和回退设定机制。控制要在上线后持续发挥作用。

questions.q: 第3章 · 上线后新增人群表现变差，训练前检查曾通过。应该怎么做？
questions.a: 持续检查分组表现并调查环境变化
wrong: 认定过去通过所以现在无偏差
只保留总体平均
questions.quote: 偏差可能来自采样、标注、训练目标和部署环境等阶段。持续观察分组表现及环境变化，不把一次检查当作永久结论。
questions.topic: Task 3.5 · 最小权限与检索前过滤 → 生命周期中的偏差

en.q: Chapter 3: A new deployment group performs poorly despite a passed earlier check. What next?
en.a: Check subgroup outcomes over time and investigate changed conditions
wrong: Assume earlier success rules out current bias
Keep only the overall average
en.quote: 偏差可能来自采样、标注、训练目标和部署环境等阶段。持续观察分组表现及环境变化，不把一次检查当作永久结论。

title.zh: 最小权限与检索前过滤 → 生命周期中的偏差
title.en: Least privilege and pre-retrieval filtering → Bias across the lifecycle

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练系统须先验证身份和授权，再检索允许资料，再生成答复。排序安全路径。
prompt.en: The case system must verify identity and authorization, retrieve permitted data, then generate a response. Order the safe path.

reason.zh: 授权发生在检索之前才阻止越权读取；生成后遮盖无法撤销已经发生的访问。 常见错误：先越权检索再遮盖输出就等于阻止访问。 回看《最小权限与检索前过滤》。
reason.en: Authorization before retrieval prevents unauthorized reads; masking a generated response cannot undo access that already occurred. Common error: Masking output after unauthorized retrieval prevents access. Review “Least privilege and pre-retrieval filtering”.

text.zh: 只检索已授权资料
text.en: Retrieve only authorized data

text.zh: 依据允许资料生成答复
text.en: Generate from permitted data

text.zh: 验证身份与所需资料权限
text.en: Verify identity and required data permissions

prompt.zh: 演练：同一模型从内部草稿改为影响客户权益的建议。选择所有适当工作。
prompt.en: Case: the same model moves from internal drafts to advice affecting customer interests. Select all appropriate actions.

reason.zh: 用途、对象和损害条件已改变，需重新评估分级及治理力度；模型未升级不能维持旧结论。 常见错误：同一模型不变就不必重新分级。 回看《按影响分配治理力度》。
reason.en: Use, affected people and harm conditions changed, requiring reassessment of classification and governance effort. An unchanged model does not preserve the old conclusion. Common error: An unchanged model never needs risk reclassification. Review “Risk-proportionate governance”.

text.zh: 重评用途、对象、潜在损害和控制
text.en: Reassess use, people, potential harm and controls

text.zh: 直接沿用原低风险结论
text.en: Reuse the previous low-risk conclusion unchanged

text.zh: 按新评估安排治理优先级
text.en: Set governance priority from the new assessment

prompt.zh: 上线清单已有发布按钮。选择生产运行还需具备的全部机制。
prompt.en: The launch checklist has a release button. Select all additional mechanisms needed for operation.

reason.zh: 日志和质量检查支持发现异常，升级与回退支持处置；仅发布或宣传无法持续控制风险。 常见错误：通过上线验收就无需运行监控。 回看《生产监控与事件处理》。
reason.en: Logs and quality checks detect anomalies; escalation and fallback support response. Release or promotion alone cannot control operational risk. Common error: Passing release acceptance removes the need for monitoring. Review “Production monitoring and incidents”.

text.zh: 只增加上线宣传
text.en: Only increase launch publicity

text.zh: 异常处理、人工升级与回退
text.en: Incident handling, human escalation and fallback

text.zh: 运行质量检查与日志
text.en: Operational quality checks and logs

prompt.zh: 将调查线索放到最直接的阶段；分类只定位线索，不代表已证明因果。
prompt.en: Route each investigation clue to its direct stage. Classification locates a clue; it does not establish causality.

reason.zh: 遗漏群体指向采样、同例异标指向标注、新人群差异指向部署环境；仍需持续分组检查和原因调查。 常见错误：训练前检查一次就能排除部署后的偏差。 回看《生命周期中的偏差》。
reason.en: Missing groups point to sampling, inconsistent labels to labeling, and a new population to deployment context. Ongoing subgroup assessment and investigation are still needed. Common error: One pretraining check excludes deployment bias forever. Review “Bias across the lifecycle”.

text.zh: 采样
text.en: Sampling

text.zh: 标注
text.en: Labeling

text.zh: 部署环境
text.en: Deployment context

text.zh: 样本没有覆盖一个受影响群体
text.en: A relevant group is absent from samples

text.zh: 相同案例被不同人员标成相反结果
text.en: The same case receives conflicting labels

text.zh: 上线人群与评估人群发生变化
text.en: Deployed population differs from evaluation population

sections.title: 有害内容与知识产权 → 采样、标注、目标与部署
sections.english: Harmful content and intellectual property → Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment

lessons.title: 有害内容与知识产权
lessons.body: 检查内容风险、资料使用授权和输出用途，设置适当审核与处置流程。不假定模型生成就天然无害或无权利限制。
lessons.example: 公开发布生成内容前，根据用途检查来源与使用条件。
lessons.quote: 检查内容风险、资料使用授权和输出用途，设置适当审核与处置流程。不假定模型生成就天然无害或无权利限制。

en.title: Harmful content and intellectual property
en.body: Review content risks, input permissions and intended output uses; define review and remediation processes.
en.example: Check publication rights and content suitability before releasing generated material.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 幻觉与可靠性
lessons.body: 幻觉可能表现为看似可信但无依据的内容。结合来源核验、数据质量检查、监测和必要人工复核来管理风险。
lessons.example: 带引用的回答仍需核对引用是否真正支持结论。
lessons.quote: 幻觉可能表现为看似可信但无依据的内容。结合来源核验、数据质量检查、监测和必要人工复核来管理风险。

en.title: Hallucination and reliability
en.body: A hallucination is plausible but unsupported or incorrect generated content; manage reliability through evidence, evaluation and appropriate review.
en.example: Check whether a citation actually supports the claim.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 检测、限制、调查与恢复
lessons.body: 记录模型版本、输入、输出和告警以便追踪；出现异常时先控制影响，再调查、修复和验证，满足恢复条件后再扩大使用。
lessons.example: 投诉激增时暂停自动发送，保留辅助起草并安排人工审核。
lessons.boundary: 事故演练顺序服务于具体条件，不是所有组织的唯一流程。
lessons.quote: 记录模型版本、输入、输出和告警以便追踪；出现异常时先控制影响，再调查、修复和验证，满足恢复条件后再扩大使用。

en.title: Detection, containment, investigation and recovery
en.body: Log relevant versions and events, contain impact, investigate and validate remediation before restoring use.
en.example: Pause automatic sending while investigating an error spike.
en.boundary: An exercise sequence is not a universal incident procedure.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 采样、标注、目标与部署
lessons.body: 偏差可能源自缺乏代表性的样本、不一致标注、优化目标和部署人群差异。对相关群体持续监测，并调查差异的原因。
lessons.example: 新地区加入后，检查当地表达方式是否被原数据覆盖。
lessons.boundary: 仅扩大样本量不保证消除偏差。
lessons.quote: 偏差可能源自缺乏代表性的样本、不一致标注、优化目标和部署人群差异。对相关群体持续监测，并调查差异的原因。

en.title: Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment
en.body: Bias can originate in sampling, labeling, objectives and deployment populations; investigate subgroup differences over time.
en.example: Check whether new regional language is represented in the data.
en.boundary: Larger datasets do not automatically remove bias.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第3章 · 材料由模型生成，团队因此省略授权和内容审核。判断如何？
questions.a: 生成不免除这些检查
wrong: 模型生成必然无害
模型生成必然无权利限制
questions.quote: 检查内容风险、资料使用授权和输出用途，设置适当审核与处置流程。不假定模型生成就天然无害或无权利限制。
questions.topic: Task 3.6 · 有害内容与知识产权 → 采样、标注、目标与部署

en.q: Chapter 3: A team skips rights and content reviews because a model generated the material. What is correct?
en.a: Generation does not remove these checks
wrong: Generated content is always harmless
Generated content always has unrestricted rights
en.quote: 检查内容风险、资料使用授权和输出用途，设置适当审核与处置流程。不假定模型生成就天然无害或无权利限制。

questions.q: 第3章 · 一段答案很具体且自信，但没有依据。能否直接当可靠事实？
questions.a: 不能，应核验支持并必要时人工复核
wrong: 可以，细节越多越可靠
可以，自信就是依据
questions.quote: 幻觉可能表现为看似可信但无依据的内容。结合来源核验、数据质量检查、监测和必要人工复核来管理风险。
questions.topic: Task 3.6 · 有害内容与知识产权 → 采样、标注、目标与部署

en.q: Chapter 3: An answer is detailed and confident but unsupported. Can it be treated as reliable fact?
en.a: No; verify support and seek human review as needed
wrong: Yes; detail guarantees reliability
Yes; confidence is evidence
en.quote: 幻觉可能表现为看似可信但无依据的内容。结合来源核验、数据质量检查、监测和必要人工复核来管理风险。

questions.q: 第3章 · 修复已提交，但尚未验证恢复条件。下一步是什么？
questions.a: 先验证修复与恢复条件
wrong: 立即扩大所有使用
删除旧版本日志
questions.quote: 记录模型版本、输入、输出和告警以便追踪；出现异常时先控制影响，再调查、修复和验证，满足恢复条件后再扩大使用。
questions.topic: Task 3.6 · 有害内容与知识产权 → 采样、标注、目标与部署

en.q: Chapter 3: A repair is submitted but restoration conditions remain unvalidated. What next?
en.a: Validate remediation and restoration conditions first
wrong: Immediately expand to all users
Delete old-version logs
en.quote: 记录模型版本、输入、输出和告警以便追踪；出现异常时先控制影响，再调查、修复和验证，满足恢复条件后再扩大使用。

questions.q: 第3章 · 群体差异出现，但样本代表性检查正常。能否结束偏差调查？
questions.a: 不能，还需调查标注、目标和部署等来源
wrong: 能，样本是唯一来源
能，只要总体平均没变
questions.quote: 偏差可能源自缺乏代表性的样本、不一致标注、优化目标和部署人群差异。对相关群体持续监测，并调查差异的原因。
questions.topic: Task 3.6 · 有害内容与知识产权 → 采样、标注、目标与部署

en.q: Chapter 3: A subgroup disparity appears despite normal sample-representation checks. Can the bias investigation end?
en.a: No; investigate labeling, objectives and deployment too
wrong: Yes; samples are the only source
Yes if the overall average is unchanged
en.quote: 偏差可能源自缺乏代表性的样本、不一致标注、优化目标和部署人群差异。对相关群体持续监测，并调查差异的原因。

title.zh: 有害内容与知识产权 → 采样、标注、目标与部署
title.en: Harmful content and intellectual property → Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练团队准备发布生成材料。选择所有发布前应核对的方面。
prompt.en: The case team plans to publish generated material. Select all aspects needing review before release.

reason.zh: 生成方式不证明内容无害或资料有授权；需按用途设置审核和处置，而不是让模型自行保证。 常见错误：模型生成天然无害且没有权利限制。 回看《有害内容与知识产权》。
reason.en: Generation does not prove harmlessness or source permission. Review and remediation must fit the use rather than relying on a model guarantee. Common error: Model-generated content is inherently harmless and unrestricted. Review “Harmful content and intellectual property”.

text.zh: 输入资料使用授权
text.en: Permission to use input materials

text.zh: 输出用途与有害内容风险
text.en: Output use and harmful-content risks

text.zh: 仅确认内容是模型生成
text.en: Only confirm the content was model-generated

text.zh: 审核与处置流程
text.en: Review and remediation procedures

prompt.zh: 演练：一段流畅答案没有支持来源，拟用于重要决定。选择全部合理动作。
prompt.en: Case: a fluent answer has no supporting sources and may inform an important decision. Select all appropriate actions.

reason.zh: 可信措辞不能补上缺失证据；来源核验、数据检查与必要人工复核共同管理可靠性，未知应保留。 常见错误：内容听起来可信就说明可靠。 回看《幻觉与可靠性》。
reason.en: Plausibility cannot supply missing evidence. Source verification, data checks and appropriate human review manage reliability while preserving unknowns. Common error: Plausible language establishes reliability. Review “Hallucination and reliability”.

text.zh: 因措辞流畅直接执行
text.en: Act immediately because it reads fluently

text.zh: 核对来源支持与数据质量
text.en: Verify source support and data quality

text.zh: 必要时交人工复核并保留未知
text.en: Seek human review when needed and retain uncertainty

prompt.zh: 演练已检测到异常并保全日志；规定先限制影响，再调查修复，验证满足恢复条件后才扩大。排列后续行动。
prompt.en: An anomaly is detected and logs are preserved. Case policy requires containment, investigation and repair, then validation before wider restoration. Order the actions.

reason.zh: 先控制受影响范围避免损害继续，再用版本、输入输出和告警追踪原因；修复须验证，不能以修复声明替代恢复条件。 常见错误：发现异常后先扩大上线才能获得更多样本。 回看《检测、限制、调查与恢复》。
reason.en: Containment limits further harm; versions, inputs, outputs and alerts support investigation. Validate remediation rather than treating a repair claim as a restoration condition. Common error: Expand deployment first to gather more incident samples. Review “Detection, containment, investigation and recovery”.

text.zh: 利用版本与事件日志调查并修复
text.en: Investigate and repair using version and event logs

text.zh: 验证恢复条件再扩大使用
text.en: Validate restoration conditions before expanding use

text.zh: 暂停或限制受影响流程
text.en: Pause or contain the affected process

prompt.zh: 演练发现群体差异。选择所有值得调查的可能来源；本题不把任何线索直接判为根因。
prompt.en: A case reveals subgroup disparities. Select every plausible source to investigate; none is declared the root cause here.

reason.zh: 代表性、标注一致性、优化目标和部署人群都可能影响差异，应结合持续监测调查，而不是先锁定一个根因。 常见错误：分组差异一定只来自训练样本。 回看《采样、标注、目标与部署》。
reason.en: Representation, labeling consistency, optimization objectives and deployment populations can affect disparities. Investigate with ongoing monitoring rather than assuming one root cause. Common error: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples. Review “Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment”.

text.zh: 优化目标与部署人群变化
text.en: Optimization objectives and deployment-population changes

text.zh: 样本代表性与标注一致性
text.en: Sample representation and label consistency

text.zh: 因总体平均稳定而停止调查
text.en: Stop investigating because the overall average is stable

sections.title: 来源授权、输出用途与有害内容 → 证据支持与不确定性
sections.english: Source rights, output uses and harmful content → Evidence support and uncertainty

lessons.title: 来源授权、输出用途与有害内容
lessons.body: 核对输入资料允许的使用方式，并根据输出用途设置内容审核、投诉和处置流程。来源有授权不等于输出一定安全，过滤有害内容也不能证明已获版权许可。
lessons.example: 公开发布前同时检查素材使用条件和输出风险。
lessons.boundary: 模型生成不自动意味着无权利限制。
lessons.quote: 核对输入资料允许的使用方式，并根据输出用途设置内容审核、投诉和处置流程。来源有授权不等于输出一定安全，过滤有害内容也不能证明已获版权许可。

en.title: Source rights, output uses and harmful content
en.body: Review source permissions and output use and operate content review and remediation; rights and harmful-content controls are distinct.
en.example: Review both use rights and harmful content before publication.
en.boundary: Generated material is not automatically unrestricted.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 证据支持与不确定性
lessons.body: 幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。
lessons.example: 回答引用存在，但引用没有包含声称的退款期限。
lessons.boundary: 检索、引用或人工复核都不是零错误保证。
lessons.quote: 幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。

en.title: Evidence support and uncertainty
en.body: Check relevance, support and source versions; communicate uncertainty and escalate important unknowns.
en.example: A citation exists but does not support the claimed refund deadline.
en.boundary: Retrieval, citations and review are not zero-error guarantees.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第3章 · 输出通过有害内容过滤，却未核对来源许可。可否认定已获版权许可？
questions.a: 不能，内容安全与来源许可是不同检查
wrong: 可以，过滤即代表许可
可以，未发现有害词就足够
questions.quote: 核对输入资料允许的使用方式，并根据输出用途设置内容审核、投诉和处置流程。来源有授权不等于输出一定安全，过滤有害内容也不能证明已获版权许可。
questions.topic: Task 3.7 · 来源授权、输出用途与有害内容 → 证据支持与不确定性

en.q: Chapter 3: An output passes harmful-content filtering, but source permission is unchecked. Does that prove copyright permission?
en.a: No; content safety and source permission are separate checks
wrong: Yes; filtering implies permission
Yes; no harmful terms is enough
en.quote: 核对输入资料允许的使用方式，并根据输出用途设置内容审核、投诉和处置流程。来源有授权不等于输出一定安全，过滤有害内容也不能证明已获版权许可。

questions.q: 第3章 · 引用主题相关，但是否支持重要结论及版本均未知。应如何表达？
questions.a: 保留不确定性并升级复核支持与版本
wrong: 直接宣布结论已经证实
删除未知标记保持答案流畅
questions.quote: 幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。
questions.topic: Task 3.7 · 来源授权、输出用途与有害内容 → 证据支持与不确定性

en.q: Chapter 3: A citation is topically relevant, but support for an important claim and its version are unknown. What should be communicated?
en.a: Retain uncertainty and escalate support and version checks
wrong: Declare the claim verified
Remove unknown markers for fluent wording
en.quote: 幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。

title.zh: 来源授权、输出用途与有害内容 → 证据支持与不确定性
title.en: Source rights, output uses and harmful content → Evidence support and uncertainty

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练报告只记录“来源有授权，输出未审”。选择所有仍需处理的工作。
prompt.en: The case report says sources are authorized but outputs are unreviewed. Select all remaining work.

reason.zh: 来源授权只回答允许如何使用资料；输出用途、内容风险、投诉与处置仍需核对。反过来，过滤有害内容也不证明获得许可。 常见错误：资料有授权就证明生成内容安全。 回看《来源授权、输出用途与有害内容》。
reason.en: Source permission addresses allowed source use. Output use, content risk, complaints and remediation still need review. Conversely, harmful-content filtering does not prove permission. Common error: Licensed inputs prove generated outputs are safe. Review “Source rights, output uses and harmful content”.

text.zh: 按输出用途进行内容审核
text.en: Review content for intended output use

text.zh: 直接把来源授权当成输出安全证明
text.en: Treat source authorization as proof of output safety

text.zh: 设置投诉与处置流程
text.en: Establish complaints and remediation procedures

prompt.zh: 演练编码：已核验=1，未知=0。资料主题相关已核验；引用是否支持具体结论未知；版本是否最新未知。修复三格为对应数值。
prompt.en: Exercise codes: verified=1, unknown=0. Topic relevance is verified; support for the specific claim is unknown; current source version is unknown. Repair the three cells.

reason.zh: 相关性不等于具体支持，版本也要单独检查；因此为1、0、0。不能将未知填成已证实，重要未知需升级复核。 常见错误：看到相关引用就默认支持结论且版本正确。 回看《证据支持与不确定性》。
reason.en: Relevance is not claim support, and version needs a separate check, so values are 1, 0, 0. Do not promote unknowns to verified facts; escalate important unknowns. Common error: A related citation automatically supports the claim and has the right version. Review “Evidence support and uncertainty”.

sections.title: 组织准备度 → 发展路线与投入顺序
sections.english: Organizational readiness → Roadmaps and investment sequencing

lessons.title: 组织准备度
lessons.body: 评估领导共识、数据、文化、基础设施与治理等维度；不能只检查是否买到了模型。
lessons.example: 演示效果好，但没有数据负责人和运营人员，仍不足以规模部署。
lessons.quote: 评估领导共识、数据、文化、基础设施与治理等维度；不能只检查是否买到了模型。

en.title: Organizational readiness
en.body: Assess leadership alignment, data, culture, infrastructure and governance required to adopt and sustain AI.
en.example: A successful demo is insufficient without data owners and operating support.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: AI成熟度
lessons.body: 成熟度描述从探索、实验到可持续运营等能力状态。它用于识别下一步发展方向，不只是给组织打一个漂亮分数。
lessons.example: 能运行一次试点与能持续监测和维护多个应用，是不同能力。
lessons.quote: 成熟度描述从探索、实验到可持续运营等能力状态。它用于识别下一步发展方向，不只是给组织打一个漂亮分数。

en.title: AI maturity
en.body: The stage of organizational capability, from exploration through experiments to repeatable operation at scale.
en.example: Running one pilot differs from maintaining several monitored services.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 能力差距
lessons.body: 从人员、流程、技术和治理找出具体缺口，区分缺少技能、缺少权限和缺少合适流程等问题。
lessons.example: 员工不会核验答案，不能只通过更换模型来解决。
lessons.quote: 从人员、流程、技术和治理找出具体缺口，区分缺少技能、缺少权限和缺少合适流程等问题。

en.title: Capability gaps
en.body: Identify specific shortfalls in people, processes, technology and governance that prevent intended outcomes.
en.example: Replacing a model does not teach employees how to verify its answers.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 发展路线与投入顺序
lessons.body: 把能力建设与战略目标连接，依据当前准备程度安排可验证的阶段目标和投入。
lessons.example: 先建立数据责任和验证机制，再扩大相关业务用途。
lessons.quote: 把能力建设与战略目标连接，依据当前准备程度安排可验证的阶段目标和投入。

en.title: Roadmaps and investment sequencing
en.body: Connect capability building to strategic goals and current readiness through evidence-based milestones.
en.example: Establish data ownership and evaluation before expanding the use case.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

en.quote: 评估领导共识、数据、文化、基础设施与治理等维度；不能只检查是否买到了模型。

questions.q: 第4章 · 试点成功后，成熟度评估最应回答什么？

questions.quote: 成熟度描述从探索、实验到可持续运营等能力状态。它用于识别下一步发展方向，不只是给组织打一个漂亮分数。

en.a: Identify capabilities still missing for repeatable sustainable operation
wrong: Count one successful pilot as sustainable scaled operation
en.quote: 成熟度描述从探索、实验到可持续运营等能力状态。它用于识别下一步发展方向，不只是给组织打一个漂亮分数。

questions.q: 第4章 · 员工会操作却无访问授权，应先诊断什么？

wrong: 只需再买一套模型

en.quote: 从人员、流程、技术和治理找出具体缺口，区分缺少技能、缺少权限和缺少合适流程等问题。

questions.q: 第4章 · 预算尚未分配，应如何安排能力发展路线？

en.q: Chapter 4: Before allocating a budget, how should a capability roadmap be planned?
en.a: Connect goals and readiness to staged outcomes
wrong: Purchase first and find goals later
en.quote: 把能力建设与战略目标连接，依据当前准备程度安排可验证的阶段目标和投入。

prompt.zh: 本演练已购买模型，负责人据此宣布准备就绪。选出下一步。
prompt.en: The exercise team bought a model and declares readiness. Select the next action.

reason.zh: 采购不能证明组织能持续使用，必须检查多个条件；回看“组织准备度”。
reason.en: A purchase does not establish the conditions for sustainable use. Revisit Organizational readiness.

text.zh: 只核对模型采购发票

text.zh: 检查领导、数据、文化、基础设施与治理的准备证据

prompt.zh: 本演练试点运行一次，团队想只报告高分。如何使用成熟度评估？
prompt.en: The exercise pilot ran once; the team wants only a high score. How should maturity be used?

reason.zh: 成熟度帮助定位发展方向，一次表现不能替代稳定能力；回看“AI成熟度”。
reason.en: Maturity locates development needs; one result does not establish stable capability. Revisit AI maturity.

reason.en: A skill gap needs learning support; absent authorization is not repaired by tool training. Revisit Capability gaps.

sections.title: 领导、数据、文化、技术与治理 → 依赖关系与阶段成果
sections.english: Leadership, data, culture, technology and governance → Dependencies and staged outcomes

lessons.title: 领导、数据、文化、技术与治理
lessons.body: 准备度是能否开展并维持特定用途的条件。分别检查领导共识、数据可用性、文化与技能、基础设施和治理，记录证据而非只填写自评分。
lessons.example: 有预算和演示，但没有资料负责人，数据准备仍有缺口。
lessons.boundary: 准备度会随用途改变，不能只给全企业一个分数。
lessons.quote: 准备度是能否开展并维持特定用途的条件。分别检查领导共识、数据可用性、文化与技能、基础设施和治理，记录证据而非只填写自评分。

en.title: Leadership, data, culture, technology and governance
en.body: Assess use-specific readiness across leadership, data, culture, skills, infrastructure and governance using evidence.
en.example: A funded demo without data owners still has a readiness gap.
en.boundary: Readiness varies by use case, not just by company.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 探索、实验与可持续运营
lessons.body: 成熟度关注能力是否可重复、可治理并能持续运营。一次试点成功与多团队稳定使用不同；具体阶段模型应说明定义和证据要求。
lessons.example: 多个演示都依靠同一人手动修复，不代表已具备规模化能力。
lessons.boundary: 成熟度模型是诊断工具，不是准确率认证。
lessons.quote: 成熟度关注能力是否可重复、可治理并能持续运营。一次试点成功与多团队稳定使用不同；具体阶段模型应说明定义和证据要求。

en.title: Exploration, experiments and sustainable operations
en.body: Maturity concerns repeatable, governed operations; a successful pilot differs from sustained multi-team capability.
en.example: Many demos depending on one expert do not establish scalable operations.
en.boundary: A maturity model is a diagnostic tool, not an accuracy certificate.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 区分技能、流程、技术与权限缺口
lessons.body: 推广受阻可能因为不会操作、流程未改、系统不可用或没有授权。先确定具体阻碍，再安排对应干预，避免所有问题都用采购或培训解决。
lessons.example: 员工知道如何核验，但无权查看原文，应解决访问与流程问题。
lessons.boundary: 相同的低采用率可能有不同原因。
lessons.quote: 推广受阻可能因为不会操作、流程未改、系统不可用或没有授权。先确定具体阻碍，再安排对应干预，避免所有问题都用采购或培训解决。

en.title: Distinguishing capability gaps
en.body: Diagnose whether a gap concerns skills, workflow, technology or authority before selecting an intervention.
en.example: A trained reviewer lacking source access needs permissions, not just more training.
en.boundary: The same low adoption measure can have different causes.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 依赖关系与阶段成果
lessons.body: 把战略目标拆成可核验的阶段成果，识别前置依赖和责任人，优先补齐阻碍价值实现的关键条件，再验证下一步投入。
lessons.example: 先统一资料责任和质量标准，再扩大使用团队。
lessons.boundary: 不能按“容易展示”替代战略与依赖分析。
lessons.quote: 把战略目标拆成可核验的阶段成果，识别前置依赖和责任人，优先补齐阻碍价值实现的关键条件，再验证下一步投入。

en.title: Dependencies and staged outcomes
en.body: Build evidence-based milestones with dependencies and owners and address bottlenecks before expanding investment.
en.example: Establish data ownership and quality standards before expansion.
en.boundary: Demo appeal is not a substitute for dependency analysis.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.topic: Task 4.2 · 领导、数据、文化、技术与治理 → 依赖关系与阶段成果

questions.q: 第4章 · 团队想从一次试点直接宣称成熟，应核验什么？

sections.title: 数据准备与孤岛 → 质量维度与数据契约
sections.english: Data readiness and silos → Quality dimensions and data contracts

lessons.title: 数据准备与孤岛
lessons.body: 检查资料质量、可访问性和共享障碍。分散资料是否能适当地用于当前用途，比单纯的数据总量更重要。
lessons.example: 多个部门各有不同版本的客户字段，需要先统一口径与权限。
lessons.quote: 检查资料质量、可访问性和共享障碍。分散资料是否能适当地用于当前用途，比单纯的数据总量更重要。

en.title: Data readiness and silos
en.body: Assess quality, accessibility and appropriate sharing; disconnected data sources can obstruct consistent use.
en.example: Reconcile different customer-field definitions across departments.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 数据策略与所有权
lessons.body: 明确数据用途、责任人、质量维护和共享规则。数据能够共享不等于应对所有人开放。
lessons.example: 为制度资料指定更新责任人，并保留版本和使用范围。
lessons.quote: 明确数据用途、责任人、质量维护和共享规则。数据能够共享不等于应对所有人开放。

en.title: Data strategy and ownership
en.body: Assign intended uses, accountable owners, quality maintenance and sharing rules.
en.example: Name an owner for policy updates and retain versions and access limits.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 基础设施要求
lessons.body: 按工作负载评估计算、存储、网络、集成、监测和安全需求，并考虑运维与成本；不只比较硬件性能。
lessons.example: 交互式客服系统还要考虑延迟、可用性和失败时的处理方式。
lessons.quote: 按工作负载评估计算、存储、网络、集成、监测和安全需求，并考虑运维与成本；不只比较硬件性能。

en.title: Infrastructure requirements
en.body: Assess compute, storage, networks, integration, monitoring, security and operations against workload needs and cost.
en.example: An interactive service also needs acceptable latency and fallback behavior.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 质量维度与数据契约
lessons.body: 针对用途检查准确、完整、一致、及时和相关性，约定字段意义、主键、格式及缺失值处理。数据孤岛还会带来重复和不同口径。
lessons.example: 同一客户有两条订单副本，先查主键与来源而不是直接相加。
lessons.boundary: 格式统一不等于数值真实，清洗需要保留依据。
lessons.quote: 针对用途检查准确、完整、一致、及时和相关性，约定字段意义、主键、格式及缺失值处理。数据孤岛还会带来重复和不同口径。

en.title: Quality dimensions and data contracts
en.body: Assess fitness for use and define field meanings, keys, formats and missing-value handling across sources.
en.example: Investigate duplicate order keys before summing totals.
en.boundary: Consistent formatting does not establish factual correctness.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

en.q: Chapter 4: Two sources differ in date and missing-value conventions. What is needed before merging?

prompt.zh: 本演练资料很多却分散、质量不明。选出准备工作的重点。

prompt.en: Exercise contract: dates use YYYY-MM-DD, missing email uses NULL, and the key uses customer_id rather than name. Raw record: customer_id=C07, name=Lin, date=10/20/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY), blank email. Repair three fields.

sections.title: 所有者、血缘与版本 → 跨职能团队
sections.english: Owners, lineage and versions → Cross-functional teams

lessons.title: 所有者、血缘与版本
lessons.body: 资料需要明确维护责任、来源去向、版本和共享边界，以便核验答案、修复错误并追踪变化。共享应保留权限而不是复制后全面公开。
lessons.example: 制度更新后能查到负责部门、有效日期与旧版去向。
lessons.boundary: 能访问数据不等于可以任意再利用。
lessons.quote: 资料需要明确维护责任、来源去向、版本和共享边界，以便核验答案、修复错误并追踪变化。共享应保留权限而不是复制后全面公开。

en.title: Owners, lineage and versions
en.body: Track accountable owners, lineage, versions and sharing boundaries for maintainable and verifiable information.
en.example: Track policy ownership, effective dates and superseded versions.
en.boundary: Access does not imply unrestricted reuse.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 延迟、容量、可用性与运营
lessons.body: 基础设施需服务实际工作负载，包括并发、数据存储、网络、模型调用、监测和故障恢复；评估成本、可扩展性与支持责任。
lessons.example: 客服系统除了生成质量，还要验证高峰响应和服务故障时的接手方式。
lessons.boundary: 购买更大算力不能替代数据与运营准备。
lessons.quote: 基础设施需服务实际工作负载，包括并发、数据存储、网络、模型调用、监测和故障恢复；评估成本、可扩展性与支持责任。

en.title: Latency, capacity, availability and operations
en.body: Assess workload concurrency, storage, networks, inference, monitoring and recovery together with cost and ownership.
en.example: Test peak support traffic and fallback behavior as well as response quality.
en.boundary: More compute does not replace data or operating readiness.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 高管支持与AI倡导者
lessons.body: 领导层统一目标、提供资源并明确责任；倡导者推动沟通与实践，而不是替代正式治理。
lessons.example: 由业务负责人解释试点目标，并支持员工反馈问题。
lessons.quote: 领导层统一目标、提供资源并明确责任；倡导者推动沟通与实践，而不是替代正式治理。

en.title: Executive support and AI champions
en.body: Leaders align goals, resources and accountability; champions support communication and practice within governance.
en.example: A business sponsor explains pilot goals and invites employee feedback.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 跨职能团队
lessons.body: 把业务、技术、法律与合规等能力放进协作机制，明确交付、评估和异常处理的责任。
lessons.example: 试点负责人应知道谁可以决定暂停高风险功能。
lessons.quote: 把业务、技术、法律与合规等能力放进协作机制，明确交付、评估和异常处理的责任。

en.title: Cross-functional teams
en.body: Combine business, technical and oversight capabilities with clear delivery and incident responsibilities.
en.example: Know who can pause a risky feature during a pilot.

lessons.title: 赞助者与业务倡导者
lessons.body: 高层赞助者提供方向、资源和跨部门协调；业务倡导者帮助发现实际需求、示范使用和反馈。两者都需要明确权责，不能只有口号。
lessons.example: 业务赞助者解决部门间资源冲突，倡导者组织岗位试用。
lessons.boundary: 热情志愿者不能替代正式的资源与责任安排。
lessons.quote: 高层赞助者提供方向、资源和跨部门协调；业务倡导者帮助发现实际需求、示范使用和反馈。两者都需要明确权责，不能只有口号。

en.title: Sponsors and business champions
en.body: Sponsors provide direction and resources; champions connect practical needs, demonstrations and feedback within clear authority.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 业务、技术与监督角色
lessons.body: 团队需具备需求判断、数据维护、技术实现、风险审查和运营能力，明确交付标准、接手关系和谁能暂停不适当用途。
lessons.example: 上线审批中明确业务目标验收者和运行支持接手者。
lessons.boundary: 团队名单齐全不代表决策机制清晰。
lessons.quote: 团队需具备需求判断、数据维护、技术实现、风险审查和运营能力，明确交付标准、接手关系和谁能暂停不适当用途。

en.title: Business, technical and oversight roles
en.body: Combine requirements, data, implementation, oversight and operations with explicit deliverables and stop authority.
en.example: Name business acceptance and operational handover owners.
en.boundary: A complete roster does not guarantee clear decisions.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 事实、未知、岗位影响与反馈
lessons.body: 沟通实施时间、已验证与尚未验证的结果、工作变化和支持措施，并建立双向反馈。不应为推动采用而许诺未经证实的岗位或收益结果。
lessons.example: 说明哪些任务会被辅助，哪些决定仍由人承担。
lessons.boundary: 只宣传收益而回避员工担忧会损害信任。
lessons.quote: 沟通实施时间、已验证与尚未验证的结果、工作变化和支持措施，并建立双向反馈。不应为推动采用而许诺未经证实的岗位或收益结果。

en.title: Facts, uncertainty, role impacts and feedback
en.body: Explain timing, verified results, uncertainty, role changes and support with two-way feedback.
en.example: Explain which tasks are assisted and which decisions remain human-owned.
en.boundary: Ignoring employee concerns can undermine trust.

lessons.title: 安全试验与问题反馈
lessons.body: 当员工担心犯错受罚时，建立限定范围的安全练习、报告渠道和改进机制。区分抵触改变、合理风险担忧和工具不适配。
lessons.example: 让员工在测试材料上练习核验，报告失败不扣采用率。
lessons.boundary: 强制使用或更换工具不一定解决文化障碍。
lessons.quote: 当员工担心犯错受罚时，建立限定范围的安全练习、报告渠道和改进机制。区分抵触改变、合理风险担忧和工具不适配。

en.title: Safe experimentation and issue reporting
en.body: Use bounded practice and issue reporting and distinguish resistance from justified risk concerns or poor fit.
en.example: Practice verification on test material without penalizing issue reporting.
en.boundary: Mandates or replacement tools may not resolve cultural barriers.

lessons.title: 从会操作到能判断
lessons.body: 按岗位设计真实任务，练习核验、边界识别、升级与人机交接，并以实际表现评估。POC和黑客马拉松也需要责任与验证目标。
lessons.example: 客服训练核对政策和升级投诉，开发者训练代码评审与测试。
lessons.boundary: 签到或通过工具介绍不能证明岗位胜任。
lessons.quote: 按岗位设计真实任务，练习核验、边界识别、升级与人机交接，并以实际表现评估。POC和黑客马拉松也需要责任与验证目标。

en.title: From tool operation to judgment
en.body: Train role-specific verification, boundaries, escalation and handoffs and assess demonstrated performance.
en.example: Support verifies policies; developers practice review and testing.
en.boundary: Attendance does not establish role competence.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 判断、同理心与责任
lessons.body: 把可重复的辅助工作与需要语境、价值取舍和授权的判断分开，重新设计人的监督、沟通和创造性职责，明确最终责任。
lessons.example: AI起草投诉回复，人类理解处境、核验事实并决定发送。
lessons.boundary: 自动化一个任务不等于可以移交整个岗位责任。
lessons.quote: 把可重复的辅助工作与需要语境、价值取舍和授权的判断分开，重新设计人的监督、沟通和创造性职责，明确最终责任。

en.title: Judgment, empathy and responsibility
en.body: Separate repeatable assistance from contextual judgment and authority and redesign oversight, communication and creative work.
en.example: AI drafts a complaint reply; a person verifies and authorizes it.
en.boundary: Automating a task does not transfer all role accountability.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 迭代式转型
lessons.body: 按构想、实验、启动和扩展等阶段逐步验证。阶段之间应有反馈与决策依据，而非一次性替换全部流程。
lessons.example: 从小范围验证开始，观察结果后决定是否继续。
lessons.quote: 按构想、实验、启动和扩展等阶段逐步验证。阶段之间应有反馈与决策依据，而非一次性替换全部流程。

en.title: Iterative transformation
en.body: Progress through ideation, experimentation, launch and scaling with feedback and decision gates.
en.example: Start with a small test and use its results to decide the next step.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 从短期成果到扩展
lessons.body: 先获得可核验的小范围成果，再确认数据、流程和支持条件能否迁移到其他团队。
lessons.example: 志愿者试点成功，不代表所有部门立刻适用。
lessons.quote: 先获得可核验的小范围成果，再确认数据、流程和支持条件能否迁移到其他团队。

en.title: From quick wins to scale
en.body: Verify an initial result, then test whether data, workflows and support transfer to additional teams.
en.example: Volunteer pilot success does not establish suitability for every department.

sections.english: Center of excellence (CoE) → Human oversight and escalation

lessons.title: 卓越中心 COE
lessons.body: 卓越中心可提供共享能力、标准、实践与协作支持。它不应让业务责任在集中支持中消失。
lessons.example: 把多个团队反复解决的问题整理成可复用的方法和支持机制。
lessons.quote: 卓越中心可提供共享能力、标准、实践与协作支持。它不应让业务责任在集中支持中消失。

en.title: Center of excellence (CoE)
en.body: A shared capability that supports standards, reusable practices and cross-functional collaboration without removing business accountability.
en.example: Reuse validated evaluation methods across several teams.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 持续反馈与价值跟踪
lessons.body: 同时跟踪使用、质量、风险、成本和长期业务价值，用反馈修正下一轮计划。
lessons.example: 账号开通数可以是活动指标，但不能单独证明业务价值。
lessons.quote: 同时跟踪使用、质量、风险、成本和长期业务价值，用反馈修正下一轮计划。

en.title: Continuous feedback and value tracking
en.body: Monitor use, quality, risks, costs and longer-term outcomes to adapt the transformation plan.
en.example: Account creation alone does not demonstrate business value.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 负责任的AI原则
lessons.body: 公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度和稳健性需要进入实际决策与控制，而不仅是口号。不同任务需要相应评估。
lessons.example: 除平均准确率外，也检查不同群体的错误和影响。
lessons.quote: 公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度和稳健性需要进入实际决策与控制，而不仅是口号。不同任务需要相应评估。

en.title: Responsible AI principles
en.body: Fairness, explainability, privacy, security, transparency and robustness should become concrete evaluation and control practices.
en.example: Examine errors across relevant groups as well as overall accuracy.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 人工监督与升级
lessons.body: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。
lessons.example: 出现缺乏来源的重要结论时，交给有责任的人员核验。
lessons.quote: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。

en.title: Human oversight and escalation
en.body: Specify when people review, stop or take over an AI process and who has decision authority.
en.example: Escalate an important unsupported claim for authorized verification.

en.quote: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。

title.zh: 卓越中心 COE → 人工监督与升级
title.en: Center of excellence (CoE) → Human oversight and escalation

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练将两项责任分到COE或业务团队。
prompt.en: Allocate the two exercise responsibilities to the CoE or business team.

reason.zh: 集中共享能力不消除业务责任；回看“卓越中心 COE”。
reason.en: Shared capability does not erase business accountability. Revisit Center of excellence (CoE).

text.zh: COE共享支持
text.en: CoE shared support

text.zh: 业务团队责任
text.en: Business team accountability

text.zh: 提供复用的评估方法
text.en: Provide reusable evaluation methods

text.zh: 确认本业务用例的价值与结果
text.en: Own the business use-case value and outcomes

prompt.zh: 本演练账号开通增长，但没有质量、风险、成本和结果数据。选反馈改进。
prompt.en: Exercise accounts increase, but quality, risk, cost and outcome data is missing. Select an improvement.

reason.zh: 活动量不能单独证明价值，需同时跟踪运行与结果；回看“持续反馈与价值跟踪”。
reason.en: Activity counts alone do not establish value; operational and outcome evidence are needed. Revisit Continuous feedback and value tracking.

text.zh: 只按账号开通数宣布长期价值
text.en: Declare long-term value from account counts alone

text.zh: 补齐质量、风险、成本与业务结果并修订计划
text.en: Collect quality, risk, cost and outcomes and revise the plan

prompt.zh: 团队只有一张责任原则海报。选择所有能产生实际评估或控制证据的补充工作。
prompt.en: The team has only a principles poster. Select every addition that produces actual assessment or control evidence.

reason.zh: 分组差错评估和异常条件测试让原则进入实际验证；仅改宣传措辞不能证明控制有效。 常见错误：有原则海报就等于已治理。 回看《负责任的AI原则》。
reason.en: Subgroup error assessment and abnormal-condition tests operationalize principles; promotional wording does not demonstrate effective controls. Common error: A principles poster is treated as implemented governance. Review “Responsible AI principles”.

text.zh: 记录相关群体的差错并评审
text.en: Record and review errors for relevant groups

text.zh: 在异常输入下测试并记录结果
text.en: Test abnormal inputs and record results

text.zh: 把海报换成更醒目的颜色
text.en: Change the poster to brighter colors

prompt.zh: 演练授权：监控员可暂停自动行动；审批员可决定恢复；模型无任何授权。勾选且仅勾选获授权的组合。
prompt.en: Exercise authority: monitor may pause automation; approver may authorize resumption; model has no authority. Select exactly the authorized combinations.

reason.zh: 停止与恢复是不同授权，按给定角色分配；模型无论措辞多自信都不能自行获得权限。 常见错误：模型自信表达等于正式授权。 回看《人工监督与升级》。
reason.en: Stopping and resumption are separate authorizations assigned by the case; confidence does not grant the model authority. Common error: Confident model language counts as formal authorization. Review “Human oversight and escalation”.

text.en: Monitor

text.zh: 审批员
text.en: Approver

text.zh: 模型
text.en: Model

text.zh: 暂停
text.en: Pause

text.zh: 批准恢复
text.en: Approve resumption

sections.title: 生产监控与事件处理 → 构想、实验、启动与扩展
sections.english: Production monitoring and incidents → Envision, experiment, launch and scale

lessons.title: 生产监控与事件处理
lessons.body: 为运行质量、日志、异常处理、人工升级和回退设定机制。控制要在上线后持续发挥作用。
lessons.example: 错误率突然升高时限制受影响用途，再调查原因。
lessons.quote: 为运行质量、日志、异常处理、人工升级和回退设定机制。控制要在上线后持续发挥作用。

en.title: Production monitoring and incidents
en.body: Operate logging, quality checks, escalation, fallback and incident response throughout deployment.
en.example: Restrict an affected use when error rates rise, then investigate.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 试点转生产
lessons.body: 从实验到生产需要明确责任、运维、治理、支持和异常处置，而不是仅把演示页面公开。
lessons.example: 上线前确认谁值守、怎样监控、出错如何回退。
lessons.quote: 从实验到生产需要明确责任、运维、治理、支持和异常处置，而不是仅把演示页面公开。

en.title: Pilot-to-production transition
en.body: Establish ownership, operations, governance, support and incident procedures before operating beyond an experiment.
en.example: Confirm monitoring, on-call responsibility and rollback before launch.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 全企业推广
lessons.body: 评估跨团队数据差异、性能、连续性、培训和支持能力，以可控节奏推广并保留纠正空间。
lessons.example: 扩展过程中发现新部门资料不足时，可暂停该用途并补齐条件。
lessons.quote: 评估跨团队数据差异、性能、连续性、培训和支持能力，以可控节奏推广并保留纠正空间。

en.title: Enterprise rollout
en.body: Assess differences in data, performance, continuity, training and support as adoption expands in controlled stages.
en.example: Pause an unsuitable departmental rollout until missing conditions are addressed.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 构想、实验、启动与扩展
lessons.body: 构想明确问题与假设；实验验证可行性和价值；启动落实生产与治理；扩展验证更多团队和规模条件。反馈可使团队返回前一阶段。
lessons.example: 实验发现资料不可用时，返回补齐基础而不是强行上线。
lessons.boundary: 阶段不是不可回头的固定流水线。
lessons.quote: 构想明确问题与假设；实验验证可行性和价值；启动落实生产与治理；扩展验证更多团队和规模条件。反馈可使团队返回前一阶段。

en.title: Envision, experiment, launch and scale
en.body: Define assumptions, validate feasibility and value, establish production readiness and then test expansion conditions.
en.example: Return to foundations when a pilot reveals unusable data.
en.boundary: Stages do not prohibit iteration or returning to earlier work.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第4章 · 上线前通过测试，但运行中出现异常。合理机制应包括什么？
questions.a: 日志追踪、异常处理、人工升级与回退
wrong: 只引用上线前测试证明安全
删除异常日志避免告警
questions.quote: 为运行质量、日志、异常处理、人工升级和回退设定机制。控制要在上线后持续发挥作用。

en.q: Chapter 4: Pre-launch tests passed, but an anomaly appears in operation. What mechanisms are appropriate?
en.a: Traceable logs, incident handling, human escalation and fallback
wrong: Use pre-launch tests as permanent safety proof
Delete anomalous logs to avoid alerts

wrong: 直接公开演示页面即算生产交付
questions.quote: 从实验到生产需要明确责任、运维、治理、支持和异常处置，而不是仅把演示页面公开。
questions.topic: Task 4.9 · 生产监控与事件处理 → 构想、实验、启动与扩展

en.q: Chapter 4: After demo acceptance, how should production readiness be judged?
en.a: Establish ownership, operations, governance, support and incident handling
wrong: Publish the demo and call it production handover
en.quote: 从实验到生产需要明确责任、运维、治理、支持和异常处置，而不是仅把演示页面公开。

questions.q: 第4章 · 推广中发现新团队条件不足，怎样保留纠正空间？

wrong: 为赶进度忽略资料和支持差异
questions.quote: 评估跨团队数据差异、性能、连续性、培训和支持能力，以可控节奏推广并保留纠正空间。
questions.topic: Task 4.9 · 生产监控与事件处理 → 构想、实验、启动与扩展

en.q: Chapter 4: During rollout a new team lacks prerequisites. How can the plan preserve correction options?
en.a: Pause that use, repair conditions and adjust rollout pace by evidence
wrong: Ignore data and support differences to meet the schedule
en.quote: 评估跨团队数据差异、性能、连续性、培训和支持能力，以可控节奏推广并保留纠正空间。

questions.q: 第4章 · 实验发现资料不可用，下一步合适做法是什么？
questions.a: 回补资料条件并重新验证
wrong: 阶段不可回头所以强行上线
questions.quote: 构想明确问题与假设；实验验证可行性和价值；启动落实生产与治理；扩展验证更多团队和规模条件。反馈可使团队返回前一阶段。
questions.topic: Task 4.9 · 生产监控与事件处理 → 构想、实验、启动与扩展

en.q: Chapter 4: An experiment finds sources unusable. What is an appropriate next step?
en.a: Repair source conditions and validate again
wrong: Force launch because stages cannot be revisited
en.quote: 构想明确问题与假设；实验验证可行性和价值；启动落实生产与治理；扩展验证更多团队和规模条件。反馈可使团队返回前一阶段。

title.zh: 生产监控与事件处理 → 构想、实验、启动与扩展

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再完成形成性应用。整章学习交付后进入正式练习、复习与错题。先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before formative application. Enter formal practice, review and error retry after chapter delivery. Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 上线清单已有发布按钮。选择生产运行还需具备的全部机制。
prompt.en: The launch checklist has a release button. Select all additional mechanisms needed for operation.

reason.zh: 日志和质量检查支持发现异常，升级与回退支持处置；仅发布或宣传无法持续控制风险。 常见错误：通过上线验收就无需运行监控。 回看《生产监控与事件处理》。
reason.en: Logs and quality checks detect anomalies; escalation and fallback support response. Release or promotion alone cannot control operational risk. Common error: Passing release acceptance removes the need for monitoring. Review “Production monitoring and incidents”.

text.zh: 只增加上线宣传
text.en: Only increase launch publicity

text.zh: 异常处理、人工升级与回退
text.en: Incident handling, human escalation and fallback

text.zh: 运行质量检查与日志
text.en: Operational quality checks and logs

prompt.zh: 本演练演示页面能打开，却没有值守、治理或回退。生产前选什么？
prompt.en: An exercise demo works but has no operations owner, governance or rollback. What is needed before production?

reason.zh: 实验可用不代表生产条件，必须落实持续运行责任；回看“试点转生产”。
reason.en: A usable experiment does not establish production readiness or operating ownership. Revisit Pilot-to-production transition.

text.zh: 明确责任、运维、治理、支持和异常处置
text.en: Establish ownership, operations, governance, support and incident handling

text.zh: 直接公开演示页面即算生产交付
text.en: Publish the demo and call it production handover

prompt.zh: 本演练新部门的资料不足，推广进度已排好。选处置。
prompt.en: A new exercise department lacks data but rollout is scheduled. Select an action.

reason.zh: 跨团队差异、连续性和支持能力需要重新核验；回看“全企业推广”。
reason.en: Cross-team differences, continuity and support need revalidation. Revisit Enterprise rollout.

text.zh: 为赶进度忽略资料和支持差异
text.en: Ignore data and support differences to meet the schedule

text.zh: 暂停该用途并补条件，按证据调整推广节奏
text.en: Pause that use, repair conditions and adjust rollout pace by evidence

prompt.zh: 本演练按阶段产出排序。只描述这次前进路径，失败可返回。
prompt.en: Order this exercise by stage outcomes. This is a forward path; failure may require returning.

reason.zh: 先验证假设，再落实生产，扩展仍需新证据；阶段不是不可回头流水线；回看“构想、实验、启动与扩展”。
reason.en: Validate assumptions, establish production, then gather expansion evidence; stages allow iteration. Revisit Envision, experiment, launch and scale.

text.zh: 验证可行性与价值
text.en: Validate feasibility and value

text.zh: 明确问题与假设
text.en: Define the problem and assumptions

sections.title: 试点代表性与迁移条件 → 值守、告警、回退与变更
sections.english: Pilot representativeness and transfer conditions → Operations, alerts, rollback and change

lessons.title: 试点代表性与迁移条件
lessons.body: 试点结果受参与者、数据和支持条件影响。扩展前检查新部门任务差异、资源、成本与用户能力，分批验证并保留暂停点。
lessons.example: 志愿者团队表现好，新部门资料缺失时先暂停该部门推广。
lessons.boundary: 把试点配置复制过去不等于验证了可迁移性。
lessons.quote: 试点结果受参与者、数据和支持条件影响。扩展前检查新部门任务差异、资源、成本与用户能力，分批验证并保留暂停点。

en.title: Pilot representativeness and transfer conditions
en.body: Check how pilot users, data and support differ from new teams and validate expansion in batches.
en.example: Pause a new department with missing data despite a successful volunteer pilot.
en.boundary: Copying a pilot configuration does not validate transferability.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: COE与业务责任
lessons.body: 卓越中心提供共享评估、标准、平台和经验复用，支持业务团队而不是代替它们定义价值或承担全部用例责任。
lessons.example: 多个团队共享检索评估方法，各自负责本部门知识有效性。
lessons.boundary: 集中所有业务决策可能形成瓶颈。
lessons.quote: 卓越中心提供共享评估、标准、平台和经验复用，支持业务团队而不是代替它们定义价值或承担全部用例责任。

en.title: CoE and business accountability
en.body: A CoE shares evaluation, standards, platforms and reusable practices while business teams retain use-case ownership.
en.example: Teams reuse retrieval evaluation while owning their own source validity.
en.boundary: Centralizing every business decision can create bottlenecks.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 采用、质量、风险、成本与结果
lessons.body: 推广后的反馈同时观察使用、结果、风险与成本，区分短期热度和持续价值，用问题报告推动下一轮改进。
lessons.example: 使用率提高而复核成本激增时，重新评估流程和净收益。
lessons.boundary: 成功案例集合不能替代完整运行数据。
lessons.quote: 推广后的反馈同时观察使用、结果、风险与成本，区分短期热度和持续价值，用问题报告推动下一轮改进。

en.title: Adoption, quality, risk, cost and outcomes
en.body: Track adoption, outcomes, risks and costs after rollout and use feedback to adapt the next iteration.
en.example: Reassess a workflow when adoption rises but review costs surge.
en.boundary: Success stories are not a substitute for operational evidence.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

lessons.title: 值守、告警、回退与变更
lessons.body: 生产交接要明确负责人、运行手册、监测、故障接手、回退、版本变更与持续资料维护。模型文件交付只是其中一部分。
lessons.example: 上线前演练失效检索、错误告警与人工接手。
lessons.boundary: 演示页面能打开不代表系统具备生产条件。
lessons.quote: 生产交接要明确负责人、运行手册、监测、故障接手、回退、版本变更与持续资料维护。模型文件交付只是其中一部分。

en.title: Operations, alerts, rollback and change
en.body: Handover owners, runbooks, monitoring, incident support, rollback, version changes and source maintenance.
en.example: Exercise retrieval failures, alerts and human takeover before launch.
en.boundary: A working demo does not establish production readiness.

lessons.provenance: AI整理的学习卡，请对照原文核对

questions.q: 第4章 · 新部门缺少试点的专家支持，应如何解释试点结果？

wrong: 仅复制试点配置作为迁移证明
questions.quote: 试点结果受参与者、数据和支持条件影响。扩展前检查新部门任务差异、资源、成本与用户能力，分批验证并保留暂停点。

en.q: Chapter 4: A new department lacks the pilot expert support. How should pilot evidence be interpreted?
en.a: Check task, resource, cost and skill differences, validate in batches and keep pause points
wrong: Use a copied pilot configuration as proof of transferability
en.quote: 试点结果受参与者、数据和支持条件影响。扩展前检查新部门任务差异、资源、成本与用户能力，分批验证并保留暂停点。

questions.quote: 卓越中心提供共享评估、标准、平台和经验复用，支持业务团队而不是代替它们定义价值或承担全部用例责任。
questions.topic: Task 4.10 · 试点代表性与迁移条件 → 值守、告警、回退与变更

en.q: Chapter 4: A shared platform is live. Who retains departmental source-validity responsibility?
en.a: Business teams retain use-case and source accountability
wrong: The CoE automatically owns every business decision
en.quote: 卓越中心提供共享评估、标准、平台和经验复用，支持业务团队而不是代替它们定义价值或承担全部用例责任。

questions.q: 第4章 · 使用率提高但复核成本激增，应该如何反馈？
questions.a: 结合结果、风险与成本重新评估并改进流程
wrong: 只保留成功案例并宣布持续价值
questions.quote: 推广后的反馈同时观察使用、结果、风险与成本，区分短期热度和持续价值，用问题报告推动下一轮改进。
questions.topic: Task 4.10 · 试点代表性与迁移条件 → 值守、告警、回退与变更

en.q: Chapter 4: Adoption rises but review costs surge. What feedback action is appropriate?
en.a: Reassess outcomes, risks and costs and improve the workflow
wrong: Keep only success stories and declare sustained value
en.quote: 推广后的反馈同时观察使用、结果、风险与成本，区分短期热度和持续价值，用问题报告推动下一轮改进。

questions.q: 第4章 · 模型文件交付后出现告警却无人响应，说明漏了什么？
